name: Tenali Rama
description: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire, and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.

videos.title: The Missing Bridegroom
videos.overview: The villagers of Tenali are flocking to Lakshmiamma's house to attend the wedding of her son, Rama. Meanwhile at Lakshiamma's house, preparations are in full swing for the wedding when Gunjappa, Rama's friend, notices that Rama is missing. Sharda, Rama's bride and his lover, falls unconscious upon knowing the harsh truth. Soon, the villagers begin their search for the eloped bridegroom.

videos.title: Tenali Saves Gundappa's Family
videos.overview: Sharda is annoyed at seeing Rama continue his merry ways and living a carefree life when everyone around him is in trouble. Sharda informs Rama that Gundappa's family will go homeless if they don't repay money to a notorious loan shark. Rama assures Sharda that he will devise a way to save Gundappa and his family.

videos.title: Tenali Meets The Goddess
videos.overview: Goddess Kali appears before Tenali Rama and asks him for his wish. Tenali Rama impresses Kali with his wit and walks away with his wishes fulfilled. Then, Tenali Rama arrives in the village and ties the knot with his lady love.

videos.title: Tenali Arrives At Vijayanagara
videos.overview: Tenali Rama travels to Vijayanagara with his family. Meanwhile, the king asks his Nagar Kotwal to catch the thief who has been troubling the people in the empire or he will lose his position. Tathacharya is furious to see Tenali Rama in the town, and he comes up with a plan to teach Rama a lesson. Will Rama be able to escape from the conspiracy against him?

videos.title: Escape From Tathacharya's Curse
videos.overview: Tathacharya buries Tenali Rama neck-deep in mud and curses him . He manages to trick a passerby and escape. When Tathacharya discovers that Tenali Rama has escaped, he devices a plan to capture him.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Hunt To Find Tenali
videos.overview: After Tenali Rama manages to escape, Tathacharya organises a hunt for him and declares him a thief. He puts Rama's posters all over the village. But when Tenali sees the pictures, he replaces them with Tathacharya's photo.

videos.title: Prisonbreak
videos.overview: Tenali Rama tells Tathacharya that he will soon escape from the prison. He manipulates the kotwal and gathers the things he needs to escape from captivity. As Tathacharya visits the prison to check out on Tenali Rama, he finds out that a fire has broken out and Rama is missing.

videos.title: A Chance To Prove His Innocence
videos.overview: Tenali Rama traps Tathacharya and the kotwal in the prison and escapes. Furious by this act, Tathacharya demands a death sentence for Rama from the king. As the King asks to find Rama and present him before him, Rama appears in the court himself and pleads his innocence. What will the fate hole for Rama? Will the king punish him with death this time?

videos.title: Tenali Starts His Investigation
videos.overview: Tenali starts his investigation to find the real thief, and he starts by revisiting all the places of crime in order to look for clues. Tenali stumbles upon a few lines written by the thief and comes up with a plan. Although his mother urges him to run away from the kingdom, Tenali insists he will stay and see this through. What is his plan?

videos.title: Tenali Reveals The Thief
videos.overview: Tenali Rama visits Sudhamini's house and is surprised to find Tathacharya. Sudhamini is shocked when she finds her jewels missing. At Krishnadevraya's court, Tenali appears and reveals that he has found out the real thief.

videos.title: Tenali Proves His Innocence
videos.overview: Tenali manages to prove his innocence and reveals that Kotwal is the thief responsible for stealing Sudhamini's jewels. He tricks Tathacharya and forces him to confess to Krishnadevraya that he saw Kotwal stealing from Sudhamini's house.

videos.title: Mallu Deva or Gopanna?
videos.overview: Tenali addresses Kotwal as Mallu Deva in front of Krishnadevaraya and claims that he is the thief. Tenali gets abducted by a few men. He is shocked to find that Gopanna, Kotwal's aide, is in fact Mallu Deva.

videos.title: Tathacharya Tricked
videos.overview: Tenali Rama partners with Gopanna aka Mallu Deva and visits Tathacharya's house to steal. His foolish assistants reveal where the jewels are kept. When Tathacharya arrives, he is angry to see his precious things stolen, and finds a clue left behind.

videos.title: The Death Sentence
videos.overview: While Krishnadevaraya gets ready for Kotwal's hanging, Tenali arrives and reveals that Kotwal is innocent. But Krishnadevaraya accuses him of lying and awards him death sentence.

videos.title: Mallu Deva Is Exposed
videos.overview: Tenali Rama tries to buy time from Krishnadevaraya in order to wait for Mallu Deva and his men to arrive. After a while, when Tenali is about to get hanged, Mallu Deva sneaks out from a secret chamber and is forced to confess to his crimes.

videos.title: Tenali Appointed As Official Jester
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya is impressed with Tenali Rama's wit and humour and officially appoints him as Vijaynagara's jester. However, Tathacharya is unhappy with the decision but is forced to abide by the king's order.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Insult
videos.overview: Tenali Rama is excited for his first day as the jester in Krishnadevaraya's court. While he looks for a seat, Tathacharya humiliates him and drags him to the entrance. But Rama uses his wit and manages to win against Tathacharya.

videos.title: The Invisible Game
videos.overview: A lady comes to Krisnadevaraya's court and tries to con everyone by telling that she has a magical saree that is invisible. However, Tenali understands her ploy and decides to use her own trick against her.

videos.title: Tenali Decides To Leave The Court
videos.overview: After being mocked by Tathacharya at Krishnadevaraya's court, Tenali Rama feels humiliated and decides to resign from his position as a jester. But he decides not to give up when he miraculously advises a little girl.

videos.title: Krishnadevaraya's Test
videos.overview: When Krishnadevaraya hears everyone gossiping about his soft corner for Tenali Rama, he decides to take his test. He disguises as a saint and visits Rama's house with his assistant.

videos.title: Tenali Rama is Banished
videos.overview: Tenali Rama queues up to collect a golden mango being donated by Krishnadevaraya. Alleging that he is greedy, Krishnadevaraya orders Tenali Rama to leave the court and asks him to never show his face again.

videos.title: Timmarusu's Surprise Visit
videos.overview: Timmarusu secretly visits Tenali and seeks his favour in protecting Krishnadevaraya and the Vijayanagar empire from the unfavorable demands being made by Tathacharya. At a feast, Tathacharya is insulted by Tenali Rama, and he vows to seek revenge.

videos.title: Tenali's Unusual Appearance
videos.overview: The council members are stunned when Tenali arrives in the council with his face covered inside an earthen pot. When asked about the earthen pot, Tenali replies that he does not want the King to see his face as it will infuriate him.

videos.title: Devyani's Gift
videos.overview: Queen Devyani from Sundergadh sends an exquisite piece of jewellery to Krishnadevaraya as a gift. But Krishnadevaraya is caught in a dilemma when both his wives crave for the jewellery. He assigns Tenali Rama to bail him out of the situation.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Evil Conspiracy
videos.overview: Tathacharya speaks to Chinna Devi and Tirumalamba and poisons their mind against each other. Meanwhile, Tenali is caught in a dilemma about the 'Sindurpatta'. His wife suggests that he gets another 'Sindurpatta' made to make both queens happy.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Plans To Expose Tenali
videos.overview: Tathacharya finds out that Tenali has replicated two fake pieces of the 'Sindurpatta'. He decides to expose Tenali Rama and asks Krishnadevaraya to get his two wives for a grand celebration. Tenali must find a way to fight back.

videos.title: Tathacharya Meets Sudhamini
videos.overview: Tahtacharya meets Sudhamini and gifts her the 'Sindurpatta'. At the court, Tenali Rama, Krishnadevaraya and Tathacharya are shocked when they see the two queens, Chinna Devi and Tirumalamba, wearing the 'Sindurpatta'.

videos.title: The Sindurpatta Secret
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya's queens are shocked when they see Sudhamini coming to the court to perform with the 'Sindurpatta' on her head. When Krishnadevaraya asks Tenali, he reveals a stunning secret.

videos.title: Tenali Rama is Promoted
videos.overview: After Tenali Rama exposes the messenger from Sundergad and the motive behind his intentions to share the 'Sindurpatta', Krishnadevaraya gets impressed with him. He announces that Tenali will be promoted as his special consultant.

videos.title: Rama's New Challenge
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya is furious when he learns that the people of Vijayanagar aren't intelligent. In order to make his empire strong, Tathacharya suggests that Tenali Rama presents eight fools in Krishnadevaraya's court.

videos.title: The First Fool
videos.overview: Tenali Rama is caught in a dilemma when Krishnadevaraya asks him to present eight fools in his court. While is family members try to tell him that it is a trick, he is determined to find them. After much hunting, he manages to find his first fool.

videos.title: Tenali's Advice To Tathacharya
videos.overview: Tenali continues his quest to present eight fools in Krishnadevaraya's court, and ends up visiting Tathacharya's home. However, when he sees him mocking and insulting his wife, he is forced to advice him and asks him to respect women.

videos.title: The Eighth Fool
videos.overview: After pronouncing Tathacharya and himself as the sixth and seventh fool, apart from the five he presents in court, Tenali Rama calls Krishnadevaraya as the eighth fool. Everyone is stunned. But Krishnadevaraya is enlightened by Tenali's talks.

videos.title: Tenali and the Diamond
videos.overview: Tenali teaches his son the meaning of Ganesh shlok. Later, another trouble comes in the way of Tenali Rama in the form of the diamond, which is supposed to be guarded by the royal guards.

videos.title: Security For The Chandramani
videos.overview: After Tenali is assigned the responsibility of protecting the Chandramani, he requests Krishnadevaraya to give him a chance for organizing the entire function. Tathacharya is extremely upset when Tenali is chosen over him and plots his revenge.

videos.title: Sneeze Fest
videos.overview: Tenali Rama, who is down with a cold, welcomes all the guests for the grand occasion in Vijayanagar empire. Looking at Tenali sneezing continuously, Tathacharya asks Krishnadevaraya to hand him the responsibilities of taking care of the Chandramani.

videos.title: Krishnadevaraya's Warning
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya warns Tenali Rama of the importance of Chandramani and asks of him to take care of singers of his court who are still suffering from cold.

videos.title: Rama's Midnight Adventure
videos.overview: Tenali suspects that one amongst the five singers is the thief who is capable of stealing the Chandramani. In a bid to find out about them, Tenali visits each of them and gives them medicine.

videos.title: Rama Overhears Tathacharya's Plan
videos.overview: Tenali Rama is shocked when he overhears Tathacharya's conversation and learns about his plan to steal the Chandramani. Krishnadevaraya performs pooja in front of the Ganesh idol.

videos.title: The Chandramani Bloom
videos.overview: On the tenth day of the Ganesh pooja, a special flower that blooms once in thousand years is brought to Krishnadevaraya's kingdom. During the pooja, everyone is surprised to see the Chandramani bloom inside the flower.

videos.title: The Chandramani Is Stolen
videos.overview: After the Ganesh pooja, a monkey enters Krishnadevaraya's kingdom and takes the Chandramani. A furious Krishnadevaraya yells at Tenali Rama for not paying attention to the security arrangements.

videos.title: The Ultimatum
videos.overview: Tenali gets an ultimatum by Krishnadevaraya to find the Chandramani within two days and is in a dilemma. He seeks help and prays to Ganesha to provide him a solution.

videos.title: Tathacharya Defames Tenali
videos.overview: Tathacharya and his disciples tell Krishnadevaraya about the consequences that will befall on those who disrespect Lord Ganesh's wishes. A worried Krishnadevaraya asks his guards to summon Tenali to the palace.

videos.title: The Chilli Trick
videos.overview: In order to expose the real thief of the Chandramani, Tenali Rama hands a pouch to everyone at Krishnadevaraya's court. He calls a monkey trainer and gets the monkey who stole the Chandramani.

videos.title: The Talking Parrot
videos.overview: Mithu, a new parrot, makes its way to the Vijayanagar empire, and Krishnadevaraya is astonished to see it talking like humans. The parrot reveals the fortunes of Krishnadevaraya, Tathacharya and Tenali Rama.

videos.title: Mithu's Word Haunts Tenali
videos.overview: After Tenali Rama comes back from Krishnadevaraya's court, he finds himself constantly haunted by the parrot's words. He tries to arrive at the parrot's motive behind speaking ill of him.

videos.title: Tenali The Ventriloquist
videos.overview: When Tenali sees a ventriloquist performing, he discovers the secret to the parrot talking at Krishnadevaraya's court. He insists on learning the art form and pleads to the ventriloquist.

videos.title: Rama exposes Samsher Khan
videos.overview: When Samsher Khan is unable to get the parrot to speak, Tenali uses his skills and speaks like the parrot. Sasher Khan is surprised and is forced to reveal his crimes.

videos.title: The Sleepwalking Ghost
videos.overview: Tenali is frightened when he hears various ghost tales from his mother and wife. At night, a mysterious beast disguised as an animal makes its way to Tenali's house. When Tenali sees it, he is scared.

videos.title: New Task For Tathacharya
videos.overview: A man enters Tathacharya's house wearing Bearskin. He tells Tathacharya about his habit of sleepwalking. Tathacharya presents this problem in front of Krishnadevaraya to seek a solution. Tathacharya asks Krishnadevaraya to appoint Tenali for the work. But, Tenali skillfully asks Krishnadevaraya to assign this work to Tathacharya as he is the senior person. Whom will Krishnadevaraya assign work to?

videos.title: The Haunted House
videos.overview: Scared Tathacharya and Dhani Mani enter the haunted house. They experience paranormal activity in the house. Dhani Mani leaves Tathacharya in the house and runs away.

videos.title: Tenali's Thrilling Encounter
videos.overview: Tenali and his family members enter the haunted house. Everyone runs away leaving Tenali when they encounter the ghost.

videos.title: Uncovering A Mystery
videos.overview: Tenali and Krishnadevaraya enter the haunted house but find nothing. Krishnadevaraya assigns Tenali to find Tathacharya with the help of Dhani Mani.

videos.title: Who Is Venkataramanna?
videos.overview: After coming from the mysterious and haunted palace, Tenali Rama reveals that it belongs to Venktaramanna. However, Tathacharya tries to reason with him. Tenali requests Krishnadevaraya to allow him to bring Venkataramanna's sons to share evidence. Will the mystery behind the haunted house finally be revealed?

videos.title: Ghost Exposed
videos.overview: Tenali presents Vishnu in the form of a Ghost before the Durbar. Vishnu tells those in attendance that anyone in the Ghost outfit will look similar.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Fast
videos.overview: On the occasion of Dussehra, Queen Chinna Devi and Queen Tirumalamba keep a fast for Krishnadevaraya's long life.

videos.title: Ramleela in Vijayanagara
videos.overview: Tenali tells Krishnadevaraya that if the Ramleela performers are unable to come to Vijayanagara then esteemed members of this Darbar will perform Ramleela instead.

videos.title: Devaraya's armory
videos.overview: Krishnadevarayas is looking to renovate his ammunition for his army and he calls upon an "expert" to show off his inventions. King and his court are impressed by these inventions but when Krishnadevaraya puts his own life at risk to test a weapon, Tenali decides to act and put an end to this.

videos.title: The New Director
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya asks Tenali to solve his dilemma: to keep mustache or not to keep one for Ram's character in Ramleela. Tathacharya gets shocked after knowing that he is no longer the director of Ramleela. Tathacharya gets scared and worried after meeting Guruprasad, the new director for Ramleela. How will Tathacharya's experience with Guruprasad?

videos.title: Navatri Special
videos.overview: SYNOPSIS Tathacharya annoys Guruprasad for giving him a fair opportunity to show his skills. After a long argument, Guruprasad assigns Tathacharya to play Ravan's role. Tenali is assigned to select other characters for Ramleela. During the rehearsal, Tenali notices a change in the colour of the wild berries. He prevents Krishnadevaraya from consuming it and consumes it himself. Will Tenali have any effects after consuming poisonous wild berries?

videos.title: Attack On Krishnadevaraya
videos.overview: During the Ramleela rehearsal, Mantrivar and Tenali keep an eye on Krishnadevaraya's security. Tenali finds a suspicious Achyutadevaraya changing a wooden sword into a metal sword.

videos.title: Raavan Dahan
videos.overview: While the Ramlila is on at Krishnadevaraya's kingdom in full swing, Ghungroo plans to attack him during the Raavan Dahan. Tenali Rama watches everyone carefully to protect him.

videos.title: Vastu Danger
videos.overview: Tathacharya and Tenali get irritated by Vamacharya for spreading Vastu fad across Vijayanagara. Meanwhile, after reaching Durbar, they notice Krishnadevaraya's throne being turned to the opposite side. But, Krishnadevaraya decides to keep the throne in its orginial position to make people believe that Vastu has no proven evidence to be true. Will Tenali find a better solution for the growing Vastu craze?

videos.title: Tathacharya Plans To Continue Vamacharya Craze
videos.overview: Tathacharya beats Dhani Mani for supporting Vamacharya. Varunmala tells Tathacharya that she got the knowledge of Vastu from his books. Meanwhile, Varunmala tells that she suggested Chinna Devi about vastu.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Suggestion
videos.overview: Tenali and Tathacharya notice that their chairs are facing the opposite direction as per the instructions of Chinna Devi. Tathacharya tactfully expresses his worries about Varunmala losing her mental balance.

videos.title: Tenali Found A Solution
videos.overview: Tenali returns home and notices that all the wooden pillars in the house are in their position. He finds that Amma has nailed all the wooden items of the house after Vamacharya's statement to remove pure wooden items from the house.

videos.title: Vastu Conundrum
videos.overview: Upon King's request, Tenali takes the matter into his own hands and resolve the issue with 'Vasthu'. According to his plans, Chinna Devi calls upon Amma as she was convinced by Tenali that she could find the solution for any kind of problem.

videos.title: Vastu Conundrum 2
videos.overview: As Vamacharya continues her efforts to establish the powers of Vasthu, as gets Tenali to a state where he couldn't even control his own head. Will Tenali be able to prove Vamacharya wrong ?

videos.title: King's Wager
videos.overview: Tenali becomes the victim of his own success when King challenges him to do something impossible. Whereas Tattacharya continues to find ways to get Tenali into trouble.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Cunning Plan
videos.overview: Tathacharya plans to put Tenali in trouble in Darbar. He decides to call Atma Swami to prove that heaven exists. But, Atma Swami suddenly shouts on Tathacharya and tells him about his sins.

videos.title: Rama Plans To Leave
videos.overview: Rama gets worried after finding a note of his name in the basket. Meanwhile, Krishnadevaraya finds himself stuck in the situation where Tirumalamba serves him inedible food.

videos.title: Tenali On Funeral Pyre
videos.overview: Tathacharya asks Rama out of concern to leave the state to stay alive. But Rama refuses Tathacharya's advice and moves towards funeral pyre.

videos.title: Rama Is Alive
videos.overview: Tathacharya gets depressed for plotting the death of Rama. He decides to apologize to Rama's family for his mistake. Tathacharya and Dhani Mani enter Rama's house. They get shocked to see Rama alive.

videos.title: Rama's Witty Web
videos.overview: Timmarasu summons Rama to the court. But, he is not to be seen anywhere. When the King asks Shardha about the whereabouts of Rama, she replies wittily which traps the court members in the web of her witty words. What is Rama’s plan this time?

videos.title: Rama's Hiding Plan
videos.overview: Rama plans to take sadhu's attire to hide from Tathacharya and Dhani-Mani. He enters Rajmata's temple and dupes her by lying of being a Sadhu from heaven.

videos.title: Tathacharya In Trouble
videos.overview: Tathacharya tells darbar to wait for Rama till he comes. But after a while, Tathacharya gets worried as Rama does not come. Later, Krishnadevaraya asks Mantrivar to find a solution.

videos.title: Identical Twins
videos.overview: Tathacharya gets angry after everyone asks him the reason for wearing the turban. Meanwhile, Mantrivar tells that there are two brothers who claim their name as Suresham.

videos.title: Hair Removing Oil for Rama
videos.overview: Dhani Mani enter Rama's house to keep hair removing oil as per Tathacharya's instructions. Meanwhile, they notice Gundappa coming, they close their eyes thinking no one will see them. Seeing Dhani Mani in the house, Rama decides to irritate them. Will Rama know the reason behind Dhani Mani entering his house?

videos.title: Rama's hair in trouble
videos.overview: Rama notices Gundappa wandering in the house holding a snake in his hand. Meanwhile, Tayhacharya rubs mud over his body to repel snakes. Later, Tathacharya tells Krishnadevaraya that Lord Shiva told him to donate the hair of an intelligent person. How will Rama save his hair?

videos.title: Tathacharya In Trouble
videos.overview: Tathacharya excitedly arrives at Saudamini's house to meet her. Annoyed Saudamini chains Tathacharya and tells that she has a surprise for him.

videos.title: Rooster Crowing
videos.overview: Rama gets annoyed after listening to rooster's crowing in the early morning. Rama gets angry after Shubhalakshmi refuses to calm the crowing rooster.

videos.title: Missing Rooster
videos.overview: Dhani Mani enters Rajmahal to catch the rooster as per Tathacharya's order. Meanwhile, Krishnadevaraya listens to some sounds and arrives at Vasudev's room to find the reason behind rooster's crowing. Later, Vasudev gets on hunger-strike for not finding his rooster. Will Krishnadevaraya find Vasudev's rooster?

videos.title: Rama Took The Rooster
videos.overview: Rama tells Gundappa that he brought rooster to keep it safe from the people who want to kill the rooster. He also tells that he tried to hide the rooster in the forest but, it followed him home.

videos.title: Rooster In Tathacharya's House
videos.overview: Gundappa tells Rama that Dhani Mani took Vasudev's rooster. Meanwhile, Dhani Mani surprises Tathacharya by showing him Vasudev's rooster.

videos.title: Lazy Rama
videos.overview: Sharda tells Amma that Rama is sleeping even after having a bath. Amma decides to wake up Rama and scold him for not helping anyone. Meanwhile, Amma tells that while returning from the temple, she saw Devaiya Kaka asking everyone to help him with farm work. Will Amma tell Rama to help Devaiya Kaka on the farm?

videos.title: Rama's Forgetfulness
videos.overview: Tathacharya presents Rama's forgetfulness in the court. Tathacharya tries to convince the court by telling everyone Dhani Mani's experience with Rama. Meanwhile, Krishnadevaraya decides to take Rama's test by asking a few questions. Will Rama be able to prove his innocence?

videos.title: Rama's Memory Loss
videos.overview: Tathacharya bribes a physician to medicate Rama to erase his memory. The physician gives the medicine to Sharda lying that it is for Rama's good health. After consuming the medicine, Rama loses his memory and forgets his own house. Will Rama get his memory back?

videos.title: Clever Rama
videos.overview: Rama forgets everything because of Tathacharya's medicine. Rama unknown to the fact that he is working in Darbar, asks Krishnadevaraya to give him work in the Darbar. Will Rama be able to get his memory back?

videos.title: Rama's Revenge On Tathacharya
videos.overview: Rama plans to take revenge on Tathacharya with the help of the doctor's medicine. The Doctor agrees to give Tathacharya a medicine that will make him behave senselessly.

videos.title: Tathacharya Becomes Doorkeeper
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya asks Rama to find a solution for making Tathacharya normal. Rama tells Krishnadevaraya that Tathacharya should be treated with multiple-personality inducing medicine. Will the medicine be useful for Tathacharya or have side effects?

videos.title: Intelligence
videos.overview: Tathacharya brings a pot full of almonds as present to the Sultan's answer. But, Mantrivar rejects his idea of presenting almonds. Meanwhile, Rama arrives in the Darbar with a pot of intellect.

videos.title: Trip To Sultan's Empire
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya decides to send Rama and Tathacharya to meet Sultan. Krishnadevaraya tells Mantrivar to showcase Rama's jar of intelligence and gold jar in the empire to praise Rama's intelligence. Will Rama enjoy his trip to Sultan's empire or face challenges?

videos.title: Rama Meets Sultan
videos.overview: Ghungru makes Tathacharya and Dhani Mani unconscious and changes the identity letter of Krishnadevaraya. Dhani Mani and Tathacharya notices Ghungru missing next morning. Meanwhile, everyone reaches to the Sultan's empire. How will be Rama's experience in Sultan's empire?

videos.title: Tathacharya Asks Rama For Help
videos.overview: Dhani Mani request Sultan to cancel their punishment, but Sultan rejects their request. Meanwhile, Tathacharya asks Rama to use his intelligence for saving them.

videos.title: Rama Fools Fakir Baba
videos.overview: Tathacharya asks Rama to find a solution to escape death. Meanwhile, Sultan's Fakir Baba listens to the conversation between them. Rama tells Tathacharya and Dhani to fake happiness for the death sentence. Will Sultan cancel Rama and Tathacharya's death sentence?

videos.title: Urgent Meeting
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya wakes up from a nightmare, and immediately calls a meeting in Darbar. Tathacharya, Rama, and Mantrivar get eager to know the reason behind calling a meeting in the middle of the night. Why Krishnadevaraya called everyone to meet him?

videos.title: War of Intelligence
videos.overview: Mohini tells Krishnadevaraya that she is the most intelligent person in the world. Krishnadevaraya tells her that she has some misunderstanding as there are more intelligent people. Mohini challenges Krishnadevaraya that if someone defeats her, she will do whatever the winner tells. Krishnadevaraya selects Rama for the challenge. Will Rama defeat Mohini?

videos.title: Competition Day
videos.overview: Mohini arrives at Tathacharya's house to convince him to help her win over Rama. Pandit Rama Krishna arrives in the darbar for the competition. Meanwhile, Tathacharya tells the rules of the competition to Mohini and Rama. Will Rama win the competition?

videos.title: Rama Loses the Competition
videos.overview: Rama successfully answers the question Mohini asks him. Meanwhile, Tathacharya continuously tries to help Mohini win the competition. Later, Tathacharya shuts the timer before its end and announces Rama's defeat. How will Krishnadevaraya react to Rama's defeat?

videos.title: Krishnadevaraya Stands For Rama
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya rejects Rama's defeat and tells Mohinidevi that each contestant should get an equal chance. Krishnadevaraya tells Mohinidevi that Rama will ask her questions. Krishnadevaraya also adds that if Rama loses, Krishnadevaraya will keep his crown on Mohinidevi's feet. Will Rama win the challenge?

videos.title: Third Chance For Mohinidevi
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya decides to take the second chance where Rama asks questions and Mohinidevi answers. But Mohinidevi fails to answer Rama's two questions. Rama decides to give Mohinidevi second third chance in the competition. Will Mohinidevi win her third chance?

videos.title: Weird Issues
videos.overview: Mantrivar tells Krishnadevaraya that Prasanna from Belamkundagram wants to meet him. Prasanna tells that his daughter wants Krishnadevaraya to choose a suitable husband among two people Prasanna came within darbar. How will Krishnadevaraya solve Prasanna's issue?

videos.title: Boxing Match
videos.overview: Amma, Sharda, and Gundappa tell Rama that they want to attain Boxing. Rama refuses as he finds it offensive. But, Amma manages to make agree Rama fulfill her wish to watch boxing.

videos.title: Rama Participates in Wrestling
videos.overview: Rama gets worried after participating in the wrestling match. Sharda and Amma give sympathy to Rama and offers him almonds for energy. Rama tells that he asked for two days before the match to think about the match.

videos.title: Knowledge is Power
videos.overview: Rama arrives at the wrestling ground to pray for god for his fight. Rama cleverly puts jaggary around the wooden rod which as per the competition has to be pulled out of the mud. Next day Rama arrives on the ground for the match. Will Rama win the match?

videos.title: Final Wrestling Match
videos.overview: Tathacharya forces Rama to participate in wrestling against Durjan. Rama gets worried after looking at Durjan's physical fitness and experience in wrestling. He decides to confuse Durjan by asking him vague questions till Mantrivar returns. Will Rama win the match?

videos.title: Traitor in Vijayanagara
videos.overview: Mantrivar and Rama get worried to see Krishnadevaraya coming late in the darbar. Meanwhile, Krishnadevaraya arrives in the darbar and starts the work of the darbar. Mantrivar tells Krishnadevaraya that they have to give punishment to the detective of enemy empire. How will Krishnadevaraya decide the punishment to the traitor?

videos.title: Krishnadevaraya's Identical Twin
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya's identical arrives in the darbar and tells that he is the real king Krishnadevaraya. To prove the truth, the identical reminds Rama and Tathacharya of visiting the jungle for hunting a few days back. How will Rama solve this issue?

videos.title: Rama Confused
videos.overview: Mantrivar and Rama plans to present a neckless to one of the Krishnadevaraya's identical to identify them easily. Rama and Mantrivar follow both of them to find out who takes the wrong turn to the guest room. But Rama and Mantrivar get confused after seeing both taking the right path. How will Rama solve the issue of real Krishnadevaraya?

videos.title: Rapidfire Questions
videos.overview: Everyone in the darbar gets worried to see both of the Krishnadevaraya give all the answers perfectly. Rama decides to ask a question both Krishnadevaraya's about his first meet with him. Both end up saying that they remember what happened on Rama's first visit, but cannot remember what Rama said to Krishnadevaraya. How will Rama solve the issue?

videos.title: Queen Tirumalamba's Food Test
videos.overview: Queen Tirumalamba prepares tomato gulab jamun for one of Krishnadevaraya to find the real King. Krishnadevaraya tells Rama to announce him as fake king, but save him from Queen Tirumalamba's food. How will Rama distinguish between identical King?

videos.title: Two Krishnadevaraya On Battlefield
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya finds out that Sultan Shamsuddin has betrayed him and has attacked Vijayanagara. Both of the Krishnadevaraya ahead on the battlefield to warn Sultan Shamsuddin. Sultan and Fakir get shocked to see two Krishnadevaraya. Will Rama be able to find Real King Krishnadevaraya before the war?

videos.title: The Real Krishnadevaraya
videos.overview: Rama tells everyone that the person who had a fight with Sultan Shamsuddin is the real king. But, everyone gets confused as Rama changes his statement saying another person who stayed back in the fight is the real king because of his calm attitude towards understanding the situation first before reacting. Will Rama be able to tell who is the real King?

videos.title: Appreciation
videos.overview: Vijayanagara Empire celebrates Krishnadevaraya's Rajya Abhishek. Krishnadevaraya decides to give presents to Mantrivar, Tathacharya, and Rama for being the special person in the darbar. Rama tells Krishnadevaraya that he has no hair on his hand because of his always lending attitude. Due to Rama's clever answers, Krishnadevaraya gives him more presents. Will Tathacharya feel jealous?

videos.title: Krishnadevaraya's Crown
videos.overview: Tathacharya invites Marquis De Pompadour to his house with a plan to suborn him against Rama. But, Tathacharya stays unknown to the fact that Marquis De Pompadour accepts his invitation to hypnotize him and steal Krishnadevraya's crown. Will Rama find Marquis De Pompadour real reason to visit Vijayanagara?

videos.title: Krishnadevaraya's Pagdi
videos.overview: Rama and Mantrivar notice Tathacharya and Mani in the market. Rama asks Tathacharya out of curiosity about being worried about something. Meanwhile, Mantrivar removes his Pagdi and while leaves wrongly wears Krishnadevraya's pagdi. How will Rama solve the Pagdi issue?

videos.title: Pagdi Missing
videos.overview: Krishnadevraya gets furious to see his ancestral pagdi missing. He orders Rama to find his pagdi before sunset and warns that if he fails, everyone in the room will be hanged to death. Krishnadevraya also tells Rama that he will be the first person to be hanged. How will Rama solve the Pagdi missing problem?

videos.title: Rama Got Hypnotised
videos.overview: Marquis De Pompadour decides to hypnotize anyone from Rama's house to get the Pagdi. Rama comes out of his house and Marquis De Pompadour hypnotizes him and tells him to bring the Pagdi in the mid-night for him. Meanwhile, Tathacharya gets excited to see Rama getting into the problem. Will Rama save Krishnadevaraya's Pagdi from Marquis De Pompadour?

videos.title: Latecomer Rama
videos.overview: Krishnadevarya tells Mantrivar to wait for all the members to arrive in the Darbar. Mantrivar corrects Krishnadevaraya and tells him that everyone is present in the Darbar except Rama. Krishnadevaraya tells that he is an important part of our Darbar so we have to wait for him. Meanwhile, Tathacharya plans to deceive Krishnadevaraya against Rama. Will Krishnadevaraya take action against Rama for arriving late in the Darbar?

videos.title: Silly Challenge
videos.overview: Krishnadevarya gets angry to see Rama coming late to Darbar. Meanwhile, Tathacharya tells both Maharani about Rama's late coming habit. Both the Maharani decide to keep a challenge for Rama to see his timing. Will Rama surpass his new challenge?

videos.title: Misunderstanding Between King & Queen
videos.overview: Rama lies to Chinna Devi about a beautiful woman meeting Krishnadevraya in the park. Krishnadevraya gets angry after listening to Chinna Devi's accusation. Krishnadevraya punishes Chinna Devi and asks her to stay at her mother's house for six weeks. How will Rama solve the misunderstanding?

videos.title: Rama Dismissed from Darbar
videos.overview: Tathacharya grabs the moment and tells Krishnadevraya that Rama should be punished for his mistake. Krishnadevraya agrees to Tathacharya's statement and dismisses Rama from Darbar's work and position. How will Rama regain his position in Darbar?

videos.title: Tathacharya Misses Rama
videos.overview: Krishnadevraya fires everyone from the darbar as everyone suggests a wrong person for the punishment. He asks Tathacharya to find the perfect person who can be punished. Tathacharya requests Krishnadevraya to spare him one-day time span to find the answer. How will Tathacharya find the answer without Rama?

videos.title: Rama's Demands
videos.overview: Tathacharya requests Rama to come with them to solve the question Krishnadevraya put forward. Rama tells that he will come to the darbar only if his demands are fulfilled. Tathacharya agrees to Rama's conditions and tells to come with him. Will Rama answer Krishnadevraya's question?

videos.title: The Mysterious Old Man
videos.overview: The King's challenge of standing in the river overnight is accepted by an old man. Tenali Rama accompanies the man as he spends the night in the river. He survives and everyone is shocked. When asked how he survived, the old man replies that he took his warmth from a small lamp in the temple.

videos.title: Cooking Food
videos.overview: Tenali Rama invites the King and his court home for supper. Everyone waits and waits but the food doesn't arrive. The extremely hungry guests get impatient and ask Tenal why the food is taking so long to prepare. To which Tenali shows them how he is cooking the food in vessels and barely letting the flames of the hearth touch the vessels.

videos.title: King Tathacharya
videos.overview: Varunmala brings a Baba to make him meet Tathacharya. The Baba tells Tathacharya that he can see that Tathacharya has a chance to live a kings life in the near future. Tathacharya gets happy and wishes that Baba's statement proves true. Meanwhile, Mantrivar arrives at Tathacharya's house and tells him that Krishnadevraya has called him.

videos.title: Sitting on the Throne
videos.overview: Thathacharya asks Tenali Rama whether he should sit on the throne or not? Thathacharya asks whether he should sit on the floor and Tenal Rama agrees. Will Thathacharya agree?

videos.title: Living Like the King
videos.overview: Thathacharya demands to be treated like the king. He says he wants to live the kings life and have his lifestyle. Tenali Rama meets this demand and putting Thathathcharya through the paces. Will Thathacharya be able to handle it?

videos.title: The Baba's Secret
videos.overview: The Baba is an agent of the Sultan. It is revealed that he has been fooling Thathacharya. Will Tenali Rama be able to uncover this treachery?

videos.title: Tenali In Prison
videos.overview: The Prime Minister and Tenali are conspiring in prison. The Prime Minister informs Tenali that his enquiries on the Baba yielded suspicious information.

videos.title: Tenali's Ghost
videos.overview: Tenali Rama haunts Thathacharya. Tenali tells him about the attempt on Thathacharya's life.

videos.title: Tenali's Secret Potion
videos.overview: Thathacharya is tired from fighting the Baba. Tenali Rama tells him that if he loses, it will be the Kingdom's loss as well. Tenal gives Thathacharya a potion that he says will give Thathacharya all of Tenali's strength. Will Thathacharya win the fight?

videos.title: The Pirate's Riddle
videos.overview: The pirates who kidnapped Tenali need him for his wits. They present him with a riddle and task him to solve it. The pirate implies that if Tenali isn't able to solve the riddle, there would be consequences.

videos.title: Tathacharya Offers to Solve
videos.overview: Tenali is forced to return to the pirate after he realises he is on a ship. The pirate tells him to solve the riddle again. Thatahacharya offers to do it. Will he able to?

videos.title: The Riddle Solved
videos.overview: Tenali solves the riddle and gives the pirate a location. The pirate orders the ship towards the location Tenali provided. Tathacharya and the other prisoners too want to step on land but the pirate forbids it.

videos.title: The Island Challenge
videos.overview: After the conch has been blown. The challenge has been thrown down. Tenali tries to convince the Jeera trader that they need to talk to him. Meanwhile the minister is concerned.

videos.title: The Game Starts
videos.overview: After the conch has been blown. The challenge has been thrown down. Tenali tries to convince the Jeera trader that they need to talk to him. Meanwhile the minister is concerned.

videos.title: The Treasure
videos.overview: While on board the ship, Tattacharya slips and falls into the ocean. Rama refuses to solve the puzzle until the pirates find Tattacharya. But, the real question is will Rama solve the puzzle and open the treasure box?

videos.title: A Tiger On The Loose
videos.overview: With the dawn of a new day, Tenali Rama’s family members demand their lives see a change for the good. Rama is asked to take his family members on a tour. Meanwhile, Krishnadevaraya’s kingdom is faced with a new threat: a tiger prowling and terrorising his kingdom.

videos.title: A Trip To The Woods
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya’s kingdom is petrified of the man eating tiger, that according to rumours can shape shift. The king and his aides, including Tenali, decides to pay a visit to the forest. Accompanying Tenali are his family members. Will they catch the tiger?

videos.title: Tathacharya Goes Missing
videos.overview: Tattacharya finds himself in trouble when he comes face to face with the supposed shape-shifting tiger. At midnight, Tattacharya goes missing. In order to find him, Tenali and Krishnadevaraya have to come up with a plan. Will they be able to rescue him?

videos.title: The Mysterious Tiger
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya decides to hunt the tiger which has become a mythical shape-shifting tiger in the town. Tattacharya cleverly escapes being caught in the middle of the act. Meanwhile, the Krishnadevaraya’s wives escape in what is presumed to be a tiger attack. How will Tenali solve this mystery?

videos.title: Tathacharya, The Bait
videos.overview: Tenali has to come up with a plan to catch the elusive tiger. He devises a strategy and asks Tattacharya to become a bait. At midnight, Tattacharya is tied up to a tree in order to lure the tiger.

videos.title: The man-eater
videos.overview: The man-eater, who has terrorized Krishnadevaraya’s kingdom is captured. Tattacharya is relieved that he is safe. At the darbar, Tenali explains whether the man-eater can actually shape-shift into a tiger.

videos.title: Tenali Finds the Culprit
videos.overview: Tenali proves that it was Lakhanna who created the myth of the man-eating tiger. Lakhanna explains the reason behind his act, which led to fear among the villagers. His sole intention was to safeguard the forests and bring an end to rampant deforestation. Will Krishnadevaraya forgive him?

videos.title: Tathacharya's Challenge
videos.overview: A man walks into the darbar and puts a challenge before Krishnadevaraya’s court members. He asks the intellectual members of the kingdom to identify his mother tongue. If they win, he will shower them with gold. Tathacharya comes forth and accepts the challenge. Will he win?

videos.title: Tathacharya's Penalty
videos.overview: The guest who has put forth the task of finding his mother tongue before Tenali and Tattacharya is enraged when Tattacharya slaps him in order to find his mother tongue. Krishnadevaraya orders death sentence on Tattacharya. Will Tenali save Tattacharya?

videos.title: The Mother Tongue
videos.overview: The task to find the mother tongue of Krishnadevaraya’s guest continues as Tenali and Tattacharya come up with different plans. Tenali manages to find the mother tongue and proves that the guest’s mother tongue is Telugu.

videos.title: The Mysterious Visitor
videos.overview: Tenali is hungry but his wife has not prepared a meal for him. This irritates Tenali and he leaves for the darbar without eating. At the King’s court, a mysterious man, who appears to be intelligent, arrives. Who is this man?

videos.title: Tenali's New Nemesis
videos.overview: Kalluri Dinkar’s wit impresses everyone at the King’s court including Krishnadevaraya. No one knows for sure what Kalluri Dinkar’s intentions are. They are unaware that Kalluri wants to humiliate Tenali and take his position.

videos.title: Tenali's Wisdom
videos.overview: Tenali and Kalluri Dinkar are pitted against each other in a battle of wisdom to determine who is better. Shardha arrives in the darbar and mocks Kalluri, who feels humiliated and decides to exact revenge on Tenali.

videos.title: Tenali's Wisdom
videos.overview: Tenali and Kalluri Dinkar are faced with a tough proposition. They have to decide the fate of a child and help Krishnadevaraya deliver a sound judgement. Heeding Kalluri’s advice, Krishnadevaraya delivers a verdict that saddens Tenali and he decides to quit from his advisory position at the darbar.

videos.title: The Necklace Thief
videos.overview: At midnight, a thief sneaks into Tenali Rama’s house and steals Shardha’s gold necklace. Gundappa tries to catch a glimpse of the thief. While trying to escape the thief bumps into the Queen’s convey. Shardha approaches the Krishnadevaraya and asks for justice. Krishnadevaraya summons the Queen and asks her to revel the identiy of the thief.

videos.title: Tenali Leaves the Kingdom
videos.overview: Tenali Rama is directed to leave the kingdom and head to his village. As per the order, Tenali and his family members leave their house. But, the Queen, who has seen the thief is still keeping it a secret. Why is the Queen keeping it a secret?

videos.title: Tenali Is Victorious
videos.overview: Tenali is proved right and Kalluri Dinkar’s decision are proved wrong by none other than Krishnadevaraya. Tenali’s advice was the right one and even Kalluri Dinkar acknowledges that Tenali is more intelligent than him.

videos.title: The Mysterious Child
videos.overview: Shardha approaches a saint, who asks her to plant a pineapple in order to bear a child. She forces Tenali Rama to get out at midnight and plant a pineapple. The next day, mysteriously a child appears.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Son
videos.overview: Tathacharya is in trouble as his supposed son has arrived home. Tathacharya is unsure from where this boy has arrived. Tathacharya’s wife too claims that the boy is his son after seeing his mannerisms, which are similar to Tathacharya’s. Who will solve the mystery of the pedigree?

videos.title: Meet Tenali's Son
videos.overview: Tathacharya’s son, Chotacharya, comes to the darbar and Tenali, seeing Chotacharya’s mannerisms, claims that he is indeed Tathacharya’s son. But, as the event unfolds, Tathacharya turns the situation around and claims that Chotacharya is Tenali’s son.

videos.title: Mystery of Tenali's Son
videos.overview: Sameer enters the wedding house with the Baraat dancing in the front. Naina's father and her brother are furious to see him but can't do anything as he came in by the groom's side. Naina is happy to see him but gets jealous when another girl starts dancing with him.

videos.title: Mystery of Tenali's Son Continues
videos.overview: Tenali proves in the darbar that Choturama is neither his son nor Tathacharya’s. Then, to everyone's surprise it is believed that Chotu is Krishnadevaraya’s son. Hearing this the King is puzzled and refuses to acknowledge him as his son.

videos.title: The Theft
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya’s kingdom is excited to be part of the sobhayatra. While on the way to the temple, the valuables begin carried by Tattacharya are stolen. Who has committed the robbery and how?

videos.title: The Grand Theft
videos.overview: Krishnadevarya is furious about the robbery that has taken place before the festival. Tenali concludes that Sommaya, who had directed Tattacharya to take a different route, is part of the robbery. But, who is the mastermind behind the grand theft?

videos.title: The Culprit Revealed
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya’s kingdom is in a state of despair. Tenali is looking to find evidence that will reveal the culprit behind the robbery. Then, Krishnadevaraya receives a letter in which a neighboring King has called Krishnadevaraya to bend the knee before him.

videos.title: Tenali Rama's Letter
videos.overview: Shradha finds a letter written by Tenali. In the letter, Tenali states that he is going to meet Dhananjay. A similar letter is sent to Krishnadevaraya and he learns that Tenali has risked his life to resolve the differences between the two states. While on the way to the neighbouring kingdom, Tenali meets Tathacharya. How will Tenali and Tathacharya prevent the war from happening?

videos.title: Rama's Daring Act
videos.overview: cannot speak. Tenali takes the task to reviving the child's speech. He does so by pushing Dhananjay off the terrace. What will be the consequences of this act?

videos.title: Tenali's Goodwill
videos.overview: Dhananjay is furious at Tenali as he was pushed by him from the terrace. When Tenali informs that his intention was to treat the lost voice of Dhananjay’s son, Dhananjay realises Tenali’s goodwill. But, will Dhananjay give back the stolen ornaments to Tenali?

videos.title: Dhananjay Surrenders
videos.overview: Dhananjay fails to fulfill Tenali’s demand and realizes that all the wealth in the world is not sufficient to meet the demand of Tenali. Before the war can commence, Dhananjay runs to the battlefield and hands over the ornaments to Krishnadevaraya.

videos.title: Threat to Krishnadevaraya
videos.overview: Tenali meets the Goddess, who informs him about the looming threat on Krishnadevaraya and his kingdom. Tenali and Krishnadevaraya are unaware that Chandrakala has been sent by the rival Kings to harm Krishnadevaraya.

videos.title: The Trap
videos.overview: Two craftsmen arrive in Krishnadevaraya’s kingdom. They meet Sharadha and inform her that they will make old gold ornaments as shiny as new. Falling for this trap, Sharadha hands over the gold ornaments to them.

videos.title: Tenali Is Conned
videos.overview: Tenali and Shardha realise that the two craftsmen have duped them and made away with their jewellery. The two craftsmen arrive at Tattacharya’s house and con his wife. Then, Tenali sees Chandrakala and realises that she has arrived in the kingdom with a malicious intent.

videos.title: Jewellery Thieves
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya is informed that Charulata and her husband have duped people in his kingdom. The King orders that the thiefs have to be arrested soon. Chandrakala is in the darbar and upon seeing the King she follows him.

videos.title: Chandrakala's Weakness
videos.overview: Chandrakala faces hostility when she arrives in Tenali’s house. After learning that it is not Tattacharya’s house, she leaves. Meanwhile, Tenali and the king’s guard are searching for the jewellery thieves. Will Tenali be able to nab the thieves?

videos.title: Revenge of the Thug
videos.overview: Bala is determined to exact revenge on Tenali. But, he intends to con Krishnadevaraya in front of the darbar, which will startle Tenali. Meanwhile, Chandralakha has arrived in Tattacharya's house. What is the reason behind her visit?

videos.title: Bala's Revenge Plan
videos.overview: Bala plans to get revenge on Tenali for what he did to him. intends to con Krishnadevaraya in front of the darbar, which will startle Tenali.

videos.title: Tenali's Plan
videos.overview: Bala and his wife move into the palace and find themselves caught in the intricate web of Tenali’s wit. Tenali wants to make sure Bala leaves the palace voluntarily. How will Tenali achieve this plan and will Bala leave the palace?

videos.title: Poison For A Lie
videos.overview: The king taunts Bala with offerings of palace and gold while being suspicious of them in turning the gold to iron. Tenali steps in to unravel Bala and his wife’s plot.

videos.title: It's Holi
videos.overview: Chandrakala arrives in the palace and watches Krishnadevaraya without his awareness. Then, Krishnadevaraya arrives the darbar and is greeted by his council on the occasion of Holi. Tenali does not want to play Holi but Sharadha insists that he let her apply color on him.

videos.title: Holi Celebrations
videos.overview: Chandrakala during the Holi celebrations decides to execute her plan and kill Krishnadevaraya. She mixes her blood in a dessert prepared for the king. While on her way to give the dessert to Krishnadevaraya, she meets Tattacharya, who takes the desserts to give it to Krishnadevaraya. Chandrakala breathes a sigh of relief as Tattacharya will be held responsible for Krishnadevaraya’s death.

videos.title: Holi Aftermath
videos.overview: Tattacharya is plotting a plan to get back to Tenali for ridiculing him in public by pouring colour over him. He gets intoxicated and employs a snake charmer.

videos.title: Kalavathi's Warning
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya assures Kalavathi that she will receive justice. Kalavathi warns Krishnadevaraya that the kingdom will be cursed and attacked by shape-shifting snakes if justice is not served. Then, seeing Chandrakala, Kalavathi gets astonished.

videos.title: Snake Catcher
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya’s council is terrified after numerous snakes entered each of their residence Kalavathi is called to the darbar and she informs that the kingdom will be cursed by the snakes. Tenali Rama arrives in the darbar and reveals his plan to call the snakes to the darbar. Will Tenali’s plan work?

videos.title: Chandrakala's Identity
videos.overview: Tenali sees Chandrakala drinking milk. Chandrakala reveals that she is a shape-shifting snake and plans to kill Krishnadevaraya. When Tenali decides to inform Krishnadevaraya about Chandrakala, she threatens to kill Sharada. What will Tenali do to save Krishnadevaraya?

videos.title: The Just Punishment
videos.overview: Chandrakala poisons the laddo from Tenali and SharadaDevi for the King. She gives Tenali an antidote for her poison and makes him take the poisoned laddo to the King.

videos.title: The Silver Lining
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya gets his finger cut from a mock duel with his queen. Tattacharya uses this instance to entrap Tenali against the words he used in wishing the king. The king asks him to prove his statement, threatening to cut his finger else wise.

videos.title: The Sacrifice
videos.overview: Tenali, Tattacharya, and Krishnadevaraya are all tied up by the tribal men. They are brought before the priestess, who selects Krishnadevaraya as the one to be sacrificed before their deity. Krishnadevaraya pulls out the sword and battles the tribal leader. But, in the end, Krishnadevaraya loses and finds that his neck is about to be chopped off. Will this be Krishnadevaraya’s end?

videos.title: Recipe for Disaster
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya, Tenali, and Tattacharya safely return to their kingdom. Later, Queen Tirumalamba is worried that Krishnadevaraya might go bald. She decides to make him a special drink which will keep his hair firmly fixed to their roots. But, the special drink creates chaos in the kingdom.

videos.title: Bearded Beauties
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya dumps his medicine for facial hair since it tastes funny. But, it falls into a plate of laddoos that all the women in the court eat. The next morning opens up to a bizarre scene all over the capital with women growing facial hair. How will the women get out of this predicament?

videos.title: The Odd One In
videos.overview: The women of the court are thinking for a way to remove the moustaches they grew due to the hair potion. Hopeless, a gathering of all the men in Vijayanagara is called for to discuss in finding a solution to this problem. But the discussion turns to a mockery which the Queen made them resent.

videos.title: The Facial Hair Conundrum
videos.overview: Tenali Rama goes in search of a solution to the facial hair on women in Vijaynagar and announces in court that all the women need to chant a hymn for 21 days and the men need to cook while fasting.

videos.title: A Cow for A Brahmin
videos.overview: There is a scarcity of milk everywhere. Tenali's mother is complaining of the unavailability of good quality milk and so is Rajguru's wife. with pressure from their home, both of them are looking forward to getting a cow. Meanwhile, the King calls them over for presenting them with a gift.

videos.title: A Cow and A Cat
videos.overview: Tenali and Rajguru bring home a cow after the milk scarcity and both of their families complaint to them about it. Tenali and others witness the milkman mixing water with the milk to sell more. The milkman apologizes to them and asks them for mercy. What will Tenali do now?

videos.title: Cat In The Box
videos.overview: The day of the competition comes and everyone presents their cats in front of Maharaj for him to decide who wins but Pandit Rama Krishna's cat is nowhere to be seen. Tenali tells Maharaj that his cat doesn't drink any milk and he'll prove it to anyone.

videos.title: The Artist
videos.overview: Maharaj paints a painting and presents it in front of Guruji and Tenali and tells them to explain what they see in the painting. Obviously, the painting is too horrible for them to explain or describe it.

videos.title: Three Dolls
videos.overview: Tathacharya and Tenali Rama are faced with a tough task. They have to find three differences between three strikingly similar dolls. If they fail, Krishnadevaraya has to oblige to the demands of Jhilli.

videos.title: Krishnadevaraya's Anger
videos.overview: Tenali Rama successfully finds out differences between three dolls, which satisfies Jhilli and upholds Krishnadevaraya’s prestige. Later, Tenali Rama happens to be at the receiving end of Krishnadevaraya’s wrath. What made Krishnadevaraya angry?

videos.title: Greed for Gold
videos.overview: Tathacharya is of the suspicion that Tenali possess a special gem stone that can turn an ordinary metal into gold. He informs this to Krishnadevaraya, who is intrigued about it. Later that night, Tathacharya decides to sneak into Teanli’s house to find out about the gem stone.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Speech
videos.overview: Tenali is startled to see Tathacharya inside his house. Tathacharya reveals that he is searching for the gem stone. A search is conducted at Tenali’s house for the gem stone. Will Tathacharya get his hands on the gem stone?

videos.title: Mysterious Disappearance
videos.overview: Tenali Rama’s proves that he does not possess any gem stone that can turn ordinary metal into gold. Later, Krishnadevaraya’s son, Vasudev, goes missing right under Tathacharya’s nose. Where has Vasudev disappeared?

videos.title: The Secret Chamber
videos.overview: Either Tenali or Tattacharya has to step inside the secret chamber. But, neither want to take that risk. Tenali presumes that Tattacharya has gone inside the chamber. Later, Krishnadevaraya assigns the task to Tenali and asks him to risk his life and go inside the chamber.

videos.title: Vasudev Returns
videos.overview: Tenali has gone inside the secret chamber to find Kumar Vasudev. Krishnadevaraya assures the Queen that he will find Vasudev. Right then, Kumar Vasudev meets the Queen. Now that Vasudev is safe, how will Tenali escape the chamber?

videos.title: Tenali Is Lost
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya is worried as Tenali Rama has still not returned from the secret chamber. Tattacharya learns about Tenali and meets Krishnadevaraya. Now, Tattacharya too has to venture inside the chamber, where Tenali has lost contact with Shardha.

videos.title: Tiger On The Loose
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya himself takes on the responsibility of rescuing Tenali. Meanwhile, Tenali, who is trapped inside the secret chamber, comes face to face with a tiger. How will Tenali escape from the jaws of death?

videos.title: End of The Tunnel
videos.overview: Just when Krishnadevaraya is about to enter the cave, Tattacharya, along with Tenali Rama, comes out of the cave. As Krishnadevaraya rejoices, a tiger too runs out of the cave. Krishnadevaraya is relived that not just Tenali but the tiger too has found freedom from the cave.

videos.title: The Visitors
videos.overview: Tenali Rama has a new plan. He and Shardha disguise themselves as Punjabis and pretend to be visiting Krishnadevaraya’s kingdom. In disguise, Tenali meets Krishnadevaraya to execute his plan. What is Tenali’s plan about?

videos.title: The Mirror
videos.overview: Tenali and Shardha put up a mirror in the darbar. Tenali invites everyone to look into the mirror. The ones who are righteous will see a glimpse of the Goddess. From Tattacharya to Chinnadevi, everyone lies that they have seen a glimpse of the Goddess. Next, Tenali invites Krishnadevaraya to look into the mirror.

videos.title: Tenali's Lesson
videos.overview: Tenali Rama explains to Krishnadevaraya the reason behind his disguise. This greatly impresses Krishnadevaraya. Later, in Krishnadevaraya’s darbar, a dancer enthralls Krishnadevaraya’s council. The dancer, who is close to Tattacharya, impresses Krishnadevaraya with her dance. Who is this special guest?

videos.title: Caught From A Different Angle
videos.overview: Saudamini Devi has got something stuck in her eye and King Krishnadevaraya helps her out with it. Queen Chinna Devi and Tenali catch them from an angle that is just too suspicious to be true. They figure that King Krishnadevaraya might be settling for a new queen. Sad and confused Queen Chinnadevi opens up to queen Tirumalamba and both of them confronts King Krishnadevaraya.

videos.title: Spreads Like Fire
videos.overview: Maha Mantri confronts King Krishnadevaraya about the rumour about him and Saudamini Devi. King Krishnadevaraya gets furious on Tenali thinking that he was the start to the rumour. Tenali confides the truth in his wife.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Truth
videos.overview: Queen Chinnadevi is determined to expose Saudamini. Then, Tattacharya is seen talking to Saudamini and the council members learn about Tattacharya and Saudamini’s relationship. When confronted by Tenali Rama, Tattacharya claims innocence. Will Tattacharya confess the truth?

videos.title: The Reacting Truth
videos.overview: It’s the poetry reciting day at Emperor Krishnadevaraya’s court and all the ministers are preparing for it. While Tenali saves Tathacharya poem from falling in the mud, what else will happen in the Royal court of Vijayanagara?

videos.title: The Trickster
videos.overview: A stranger heads into Vijaynagara and tricks Acharya into thinking he wants a shelter for a night, finally he dupes Acharya and makes him look like a fool. Tenali is all set to catch this man.

videos.title: Tenali Knows Best
videos.overview: The trickster, who recently cheated Acharya Chakra Pani, is now at Tenali’s home pretending to be Tenali’s childhood friend Gopal Krishna. Watch how Tenali teaches the cheat a lesson and makes him admit his frauds.

videos.title: Lesson Learnt
videos.overview: It’s Tenali’s turn to trick Rajguru Acharya Tathacharya. Tenali dresses up as a visitor and gives Tathacharya the duty to protect a sack of gold coins, but what Tathacharya doesn’t know is that it’s a sack of stones. A foreign explorer from Portugal Domingo Paes is on his way to the kingdom of Vijayanagara.

videos.title: Good Food or Good Wife
videos.overview: King Krishnadevraya's has a case of a bad stomach ache and he thinks that Queen Tirumalamba’s cooking might be the cause. While queen Tirumalamba brings more dishes for the King, the King is fed up with it. Tenali is called, watch how he brings a witty solution.

videos.title: Visitor From Portugal
videos.overview: Vijayanagar has a guest from Portugal and he wishes to write about the prosperous kingdom in his book. This text would help the upcoming generations, to learn and respect the great empire. The courtiers are excited about the development and are all keen to have their story in the book. How would Vijayanagar react to welcome their guest?

videos.title: Put Your Name In History
videos.overview: Domingo Paes have come all the way from Portuguese to write his novel about Vijayanagara empire. Tathacharya is all set and excited about his visit and wants to put his name down in Paes’s novel.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Plan
videos.overview: Domingo is touring Vijayanagar and documenting the everyday happenings. Krishnadevaraya's council wants to prove their superiority over others. Tattacharya suggests to Krishnadevaraya that Domingo's documents will prove that Vijayanagar is one of the greatest kingdoms to the western world. Tattacharya has a plan up his sleeve to put his name in Domingo's documents.

videos.title: The Winds of War
videos.overview: Domingo is touring Vijayanagar and documenting the everyday happenings. Krishnadevaraya's council wants to prove their superiority over others. Tattacharya suggests to Krishnadevaraya that Domingo's documents will prove that Vijayanagar is one of the greatest kingdoms to the western world. Tattacharya has a plan up his sleeve to put his name in Domingo's documents.

videos.title: Women of Vijayanagara
videos.overview: Domingo Paes is writing his book about Vijaynagara. Emperor Krishnadevaraya is all set for a war with Narsingh Vardhan. All the women of Vijaynagara surprisingly get to the battle field to represent the women and get their names down in history.

videos.title: The Peacekeeper
videos.overview: Anand find the envolpe with money inside Naina’s washroom, although disappointed with Naina, he forgives her. Naina sneaks her way to Sameer’s place to catch a glimpse of him after a year, but Sameer is still angry with Naina.

videos.title: Friend From Afar
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya is worried about his ally and friend Dharampal. To Krishnadevaraya's surprise, Dharampal pays a surprise visit to Vijayanagar with his wife. What is the purpose of Dharampal's visit?

videos.title: Split Personality
videos.overview: Munmun has a drastic change in personality after drinking a special juice made by Tirumalamba. Munmun picks up a sword and starts attacking the ones surrounding her. Krishnadevaraya is furious after learning that Tirumalamba's special drink made Munmun angry.

videos.title: The Queen Goes Missing
videos.overview: Munmun sneaks out of the palace in the guise of a servant. Tenali and Shardha do not find Munmun and inform Krishnadevaraya. Before Munmun can be found, Dharampal arrives at the palace. Will Dharampal find out that his beloved Queen has disappeared?

videos.title: Tathacharya's Punishment
videos.overview: Munmun appears at Tattacharya's house but not as herself. Munmun thinks she is Amma and starts punishing Tattacharya. Later, Munmun is Jwala, a bandit. Will Tenali find a solution to Munmun's split personality?

videos.title: Queen Becomes Bandit
videos.overview: Munmun thinks she is a bandit, Jwala and terrorizes the citizens of Vijayanagar. Krishnadevaraya tries to halt Munmun's bandit way of life. Seeing Dharampal approaching, Tenali diverts the attention of Munmun so that Dharampal doesn't see her as a bandit. Will Munmun regain her senses?

videos.title: Sharda's Father Pays A Visit
videos.overview: Munmun now thinks she is Shardha's father and arrives at Tenali Rama's house. Gundappa, after searching for Tenali, informs him that his father-in-law has arrived. Meanwhile, Dharampal is eager to meet his wife, but Krishnadevaraya keeps him busy until the queen comes to her senses.

videos.title: Trapped In Love
videos.overview: Tenali solves the mystery behind Munmun's various disguises. When Dharampal arrives in the darbar, Tenali explains to the king that Munmun is trapped in his obsessive love and this is affecting her psychologically, which explains her various disguises.

videos.title: A New Problem
videos.overview: Dharampal learns his lesson and decides to return to his kingdom. Then, another complicated case comes to Krishnadevaraya's darbar. Tenali has to solve the case of the Kotwal and his wife who are arguing about an issue.

videos.title: Seeds Of War
videos.overview: Mughal Emperor Babar has sent a spy in Vijayanagar. Meanwhile, Tenali has a nightmare in which he has been captured by Babar's army. Tenali fears that the Mughal forces will march towards Vijayanagar. Before Babar plans his attack, he has planned to beat Tenali at his own game.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Suspicion
videos.overview: Dhani and Mani inform Tathacharya about the visitor. Based on Dhani and Mani's description, Tathacharya suspects that the visitor has been sent by Mughal emperor Babar, probably to spy on Vijayanagar. Will Tenali Rama find out that he is the target for Babar?

videos.title: The Traitor
videos.overview: Babar's spy sneaks into Tenali Rama's house at midnight. Following the spy is Tathacharya, who also enters Tenali's house. The spy makes Tathacharya believe that Tenali is planning to dethrone Krishnadevaraya and become the king. Tathacharya believes the spy's word and informs Tenali that he will alert Krishnadevaraya.

videos.title: Treason
videos.overview: Tathacharya accuses Tenali Rama of treason and informs Krishnadevaraya about it. Krishnadevaraya immediately summons the guards and asks them to arrest Tenali and hang him. How will Tenali get out of this mess and prove his innocence?

videos.title: Rama's Plan
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya surprises Tenali by assuring him of his trust in Tenali Rama's loyalty. Tenali asks Krishnadevaraya to let him meet Babur and convince him to abandon the idea of war. Will Tenali Rama's plan work?

videos.title: Tenali's Journey Begins
videos.overview: Tenali Rama convinces his mother and packs his bags to head towards Agra to meet Babar. Tattacharya is displeased with Tenali’s visit to Agra. He decides to follow Tenali Rama and find out if he is Babar’s spy.

videos.title: Tenali's Solution
videos.overview: While on the way to Agra, Tenali sees Tattacharya following him. Tenali manages to deceive Tattacharya and arrives at Agra. While at Agra, Tenali comes across a man who has been separated from his wife for a minor issue. Tenali decides to take matters into his own hands and solve the man’s problem.

videos.title: Tenali Meets Babar
videos.overview: Tenali Rama notices Tattacharya’s arrival in Agra and gets him beaten up by a crowd. Later, Tenali and Tattacharya join hands to save Vijayanagar. Then, Tenali arrives in Babar’s court and dares to look him in the eye and deliver his message.

videos.title: Laughter Challenge
videos.overview: Tenali Rama notices Tattacharya’s arrival in Agra and gets him beaten up by a crowd. Later, Tenali and Tattacharya join hands to save Vijayanagar. Then, Tenali arrives in Babar’s court and dares to look him in the eye and deliver his message.

videos.title: The Battle Begins
videos.overview: Tenali Rama notices Tattacharya’s arrival in Agra and gets him beaten up by a crowd. Later, Tenali and Tattacharya join hands to save Vijayanagar. Then, Tenali arrives in Babar’s court and dares to look him in the eye and deliver his message.

videos.title: Rama's Last Wish
videos.overview: Tenali Rama asks for his last wish to be fulfilled before the sentence is implemented. Tenali asks for the guard to be summoned. Tenali proves to Babar that anyone can enter his kingdom without guards supervision. Babar is shocked to hear this. How will Tenali escape Babar's wrath?

videos.title: Tathacharya's Trick
videos.overview: In order to help Tenali Rama win the poetry battle, Tattacharya steals all the betel quids under Babban Miya's possession. Without the betel quids, Babban Miya loses concentration and Tenali Rama gains an upper hand. Will Babar find out Tattacharya's trick?

videos.title: Rama's New Competitor
videos.overview: Tenali reveals to Babar that Babban Miya's betel quids were stolen by Tattacharya. An infuriated Babar announces that Tenali Rama will face Maya Devi in a battle to be the wittiest. Will Tenali Rama emerge the winner?

videos.title: The Three Doors
videos.overview: Tenali reveals to Babar that Babban Miya's betel quids were stolen by Tattacharya. An infuriated Babar announces that Tenali Rama will face Maya Devi in a battle to be the wittiest. Will Tenali Rama emerge the winner?

videos.title: Tenali's Disguise
videos.overview: As the Sehansha disperses money to the poor, Tenali disguises him self as an old poor man, to trick the Emperor. But things turn out not how he had expected it.

videos.title: The Bow and Arrow
videos.overview: Tenali’s wife has taken up a new skill of archery but she isn’t quite good at it. On the royal court, the king questions Tathacharya about his whereabouts. There is good news as Mughal Raj Babar leaves and declares that there is no more a war between the two kingdoms.

videos.title: The Ritual
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya dispises Prataprudradev, the neighboring king. He learns that Pratap is coming to perform the Rudrabhishek. But, Krishnadevaraya too wants to perform the ritual. This creates a conflict and the two kings refuse to budge. Does Tenali Rama have a solution to this problem?

videos.title: First In Line
videos.overview: As it’s a special occasion and Emperor Krishnadevaraya has reached the Shiva temple, in this purpose, there he meets Emperor Pratap who is also there for the same. Now both the Emperors fight it out that who will be the first one. Tenali saves the day with his idea.

videos.title: Tenali's Nightmare
videos.overview: Tathacharya's manages to save his head from getting decapitated as Krishnadevaraya and Prataprudradev realize their mistake and spare Tathacharya's life. Later, Tenali wakes up in the middle of the night following a nightmare and decides to take Krishnadevaraya back to his kingdom before things get worse.

videos.title: Brewing Love
videos.overview: Tathacharya uses his disciples to teach Prataprudradev's advisor a lesson. Tenali Rama sees Prataprudradev's daughter trying to befriend Krishnadevaraya. Prataprudradev gets into an argument with Krishnadevaraya after seeing his daughter with the Vijayanagar king. Will this be the reason for war?

videos.title: Rama's Predicament
videos.overview: Shardha and Amma are on their way to warn the two queens about Jaganmohini when Tenali Rama stops them. Tenali Rama pleads with Shardha and Amma to stay away from the queens. Nevertheless, Shardha and Amma watch Jaganmohini and her mother closely. As Tenali Rama tries to avoid one troublesome situation another comes knocking.

videos.title: The Rightful Judgement
videos.overview: Shardha and Amma cajole Gundappa to instigate Chinnadevi and Tirumalammba against Jaganmohini. Meanwhile, Tenali Rama helps Krishnadevaraya deliver rightful judgment, which impresses Prataprudradev. Things get complicated when Prataprudradev asks Krishnadevaraya to let him take Tenali Rama as his council member.

videos.title: Tenali In Trouble
videos.overview: Tenali Rama gets into a dispute with Emperor Krishnadevaraya, and finally the decision is taken that he will be sent off to another Empire. Gundappa gets the queens in trouble by telling them what not.

videos.title: The Solution
videos.overview: Chinnadevi and Tirumalamba discover the real side of Prataprudradev's wife and daughter. Later, Shardha claims that she has been duped by Amma and produces a necklace as proof to Krishnadevaraya. Tattacharya opines that Tenali Rama should settle his family dispute inside the confines of his house. Will Krishnadevaraya offer a solution?

videos.title: Tit For Tat
videos.overview: Prataprudradev is impressed by Tattacharya's wisdom and wants to take him to his kingdom. Tattacharya realizes that the dispute he settled between Amma and Shardha was a ploy of Tenali Rama. As Tattacharya bids adieu, Tenali Rama informs him that he played a trick used by Tattacharya himself to get rid of the grand old master.

videos.title: The Complicated Will
videos.overview: Shardha wants to inform Tenali Rama that she is pregnant but Tenali Rama is in a hurry to reach the Darbar. After reaching the Darbar, Krishnadevaraya tests Tenali Rama's intelligence by asking him to settle a matter. Three sons claim ownership to their father's diamonds. The will left by the father is complicated and has confused everyone. Will Tenali Rama be able to settle the matter?

videos.title: The Good News
videos.overview: Tenali Rama informs Krishnadevaraya that Rameshwar Rao never intended to divide his wealth between his sons. While the dispute is finally settled, back home, a new one crops up. Amma believes that Shardha is pregnant, after overhearing Shardha's conversation with her friend. When Amma informs Tenali Rama that his wife is expecting, Tenali Rama's joy knows no bounds.

videos.title: Jealous Tathacharya
videos.overview: Tenali Rama puts forth a request before Krishnadevaraya that he should be allowed to come late to the darbar as Shardha is pregnant. Krishnadevaraya is pleased to hear the news. But, Tattacharya is displeased. Tattacharya thinks Tenali Rama is lying and decides to find out.

videos.title: Trouble In The Tummy
videos.overview: A misunderstanding in an overheard conversation leads to the thought that Tenali's wife is pregnant. Tenali's mother is preparing a celebration for it, but the truth is not so obvious. Tathacharya tries to impress Mala but fortune doesn't really favor him, things turn dry quite quickly.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Plan
videos.overview: Tathacharya plans to unveil the truth about Tenali's wife not being pregnant in front of everyone in the Raj Mahal after he overheard Tenali and Sharda talking to each other. Tenali and Sharda are worried after they are not able to tell their mother the truth about her pregnancy. What will happen now?

videos.title: Taking Responsibilities
videos.overview: Tenali takes a sigh of relief after the doctor tells everyone that Sharda is actually pregnant so Tenali takes the responsibilities of all the household errands. Maharaj receives three vases as a gift and Kotwal breaks one of them by mistake so Maharaj gets furious and gives him the death penalty. What will happen now?

videos.title: Protect the Vase
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya bestows the responsibility of protecting the vases to his two queens and Tattacharya, who reluctantly takes the vase to his home. Dhani and Mani try to break the vase so that Tattacharya is left red-faced in front of Krishnadevaraya. Will Tattacharya be able to protect the vase?

videos.title: Tenali In Trouble
videos.overview: After Maharaj announces the death penalty for Kotwal for breaking the flower pot, Tenali comes forward to protect him but all hell breaks loose when Maharaj transfers Kotwal's death penalty to Pandit Rama. What will Pandit Ramakrishna do now?

videos.title: Tathacharya In A Fix
videos.overview: Shardha and Amma learn that Tenali Rama has been sentenced to death by Krishnadevaraya. They meet Tenali Rama in prison. Seeing the presence of Kotwal in the prison, Amma beats him up and holds him responsible for Tenali Rama's trouble. Later, Tattacharya meets Krishnadevaraya and returns the vase to him. Krishnadevaraya cleverly traps Tattacharya and hands over not one but two vases to Tattacharya.

videos.title: Rama's Death Sentence
videos.overview: Tenali Rama wants Krishnadevaraya to fulfill his last wish. Krishnadevaraya presumes that Tenali Rama will ask for his death sentence to be pardoned but Tenali Rama's last wish is unique. Tenali Rama gets his hands on the two vases and shatters them into pieces. Will Krishnadevaraya pardon Tenali Rama after this act?

videos.title: The Curious Case of Kamal Rao
