videos.overview: A trader comes with a problem before Krishnadevaraya. The trader is unable to find a bride for his son, Kamal Rao. When the trader announces that he will give half of his wealth to the one who finds a solution, Tattacharya steps forward. Instead of giving the solution, Tattacharya complicates the matter. Will Tenali Rama provide a solution?

videos.title: The Good Deeds
videos.overview: Tathacharya plans to convert Tenali's unborn son into his own devotee so he sends Varunmala to Pandit Rama's house to share his stories with Sharda and her unborn child. Krishnadevraya's both wives Maharani Chinnadevi and Maharani Tirumala Devi also visit Sharda to give her the food they prepared. All this happens while Tenali is stuck in the attic. How did Pandit Rama got stuck in the attic?

videos.title: Nine Months Later
videos.overview: The story takes a leap of nine months and Pandit Rama's son is here and it's his naming ceremony in the Darbar of Krishnadevraya so everyone gets ready early morning. But Tathacharya has different plans for Pandit Rama and his son.

videos.title: Bad Omen
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya chooses the name 'Prabhudeva' for Tenali Rama's son. During the naming ceremony, Tattacharya announces that Tenali Rama's son is a bad omen for Vijayanagar. One after the other, bad news reaches Krishnadevaraya and Tattacharya requests the King that Tenali Rama's son shouldn't stay in Vijayanagar anymore.

videos.title: Banished
videos.overview: Tenali accepts the banishment after Tathacharya convinces Krishnadevraya that Tenali's son Prabhudeva is a bad omen for Vijaynagar so he with his entire family leaves Vijayanagar to live on the outskirts. But Tenali knows Tathacharya's intentions so forms a plan of his own.

videos.title: Envious Tathacharya
videos.overview: Tathacharya is envious of Tenali Rama's son and the gifts that are being showered on the newborn. With a bad intention, Tathacharya arrives at Tenli Rama's house. Tenali Rama is aware of Tathacharya's intent and turns the table on the grand old master. Tathacharya is left red-faced and beats a hasty retreat.

videos.title: The Gifts
videos.overview: Krishnadevraya announces that he is going to shower a Pandit with a lot of expensive gifts as a bonus for dedicating his life towards the welfare of the country. Tathacharya believes that the gifts are for him and gets ready to receive them the next day at the court.

videos.title: The Naming Ceremony
videos.overview: Tathacharya changes his plans and informs Pandit Rama that he can come back to the city with his newborn and his entire family as the bad omen that his son brought with him might contribute towards the welfare of the city. Pandit Rama enters the darbar with his newborn for his naming ceremony.

videos.title: Perks of Being a Father
videos.overview: Tenali Rama loses sleep due to his son's constant crying. He is forced to take care of his son while Amma and Shardha become spectators. Later, Surya and Chandra Rao seek justice from Krishnadevaraya. Chandra Rao had sold a well to Surya Rao. Now, Chandra Rao is cleverly manipulating the terms by stating that Surya Rao has bought the well only and not the water inside it. Tattacharya declares the judgment in favor of Chandra Rao, Now it's up to Tenali Rama to give justice to Surya Rao.

videos.title: The Punishment
videos.overview: Since Chandra Rao tried to dupe Surya Rao, Krishnadevaraya asks Tenali Rama to announce the punishment for Chandra Rao. Tenali Rama asks Chandra Rao to return the money given by Surya Rao for buying the well. Meanwhile, Tenali Rama is finding it difficult to juggle between work and taking care of his newborn child.

videos.title: Burning the Midnight Oil
videos.overview: Tenali Rama is caught snoring in the darbar. An enraged Krishnadevaraya warns Tenali Rama that if he is caught sleeping in the darbar again, he will be punished. Later, Rameshwar seeks advice from Krishnadevaraya's council about a family dispute. Rameshwar's father has passed away and he is afraid that his father's second wife will demand a share in the property. Who will solve this issue: Tenali Rama or Tattacharya?

videos.title: Irresponsibility
videos.overview: Pandit Rama brings Bhaskar with him to the court and everyone including both the wives of Krishnadevraya start playing with him which irritates Tathacharya. Pandit Rama then takes Bhaskar to the market to buy some fruits and irresponsibly leaves him at the fruit vendor's shop. What will happen now?

videos.title: Finding Bhaskar
videos.overview: Sharda is furious at Pandit Rama after he loses Bhaskar in the market so they go out looking for him everywhere. Pandit Rama gets to know that Tathacharya took Bhaskar with him and plans to inform Krishnadevraya about his irresponsibility. So he plans to retrieve Bhaskar from Tathacharya and also teach Tathacharya a lesson.

videos.title: Tathacharya Embarrassed
videos.overview: Tathacharya tries to humiliate Tenali Rama in front of the darbar but ends up getting embarrassed himself. Unaware that Bhaskar is not in the basket, Tathacharya goes on a rant against Tenali Rama. When Bhaskar returns to his mother, Krishnadevaraya advises Tenali Rama to take care of his son.

videos.title: The Conman
videos.overview: Guthilal has arrived in Vijayanagar with an intent to rob Krishnadevaraya of his wealth. He sneaks into the darbar and plays with Tathacharya's intellect. Tathacharya falls in the trap set up by Guthilal. While the council members are busy, Guthilal's men steal the royal seal. Will Tenali Rama save Vijayanagar?

videos.title: Finding the Solution
videos.overview: After Tathacharya is forced to call Pandit Rama to the court to help him solve the problem created by Guthilal, Pandit Rama comes to the court with his entire family and continues to do his household chores in the court itself. Pandit Rama comes to know about the entire charade around Guthilal and decides to solve his puzzle.

videos.title: Bhaskar's Heroic Act
videos.overview: While Guthilal and his men are busy searching for the royal seal, Bhaskar does a heroic act by getting hold of the seal before it gets into the wrong hands. Tenali Rama and Tathacharya learn that Guthilal and his men tried to steal the seal. While Guthilal is taken into custody, Bhaskar is hailed as the hero.

videos.title: The Marriage Conundrum
videos.overview: A lady comes to the court looking for a solution for her marital problem claiming that her husband married her but never gave her the position of a wife in his life. Her husband brushes off her allegations and claims that he is married to someone else. Witnessing the helplessness of the wife, Tathacharya decides to marry the lady himself.

videos.title: The Second Marriage
videos.overview: A hill tribe comes to the court and the leader of the tribe claims that Tathacharya blessed his sister and now has to marry her according to the rules of their tribe. Pandit Rama enters the darbar trying to find Bhaskar's ornament. Tathacharya tries to find the solution to this problem.

videos.title: Tathacharya in Trouble
videos.overview: Tathacharya's wife is furious that she hasn't be invited to Tathacharya's second marriage. Tathacharya and his bride arrive at the house to a grand welcome. Meanwhile, Amma suggests to Shardha that she should give birth to another child so that Bhaskar as a sibling to play with. Then, Dhani and Mani meet Tenali Rama and seek his help to save Tathacharya.

videos.title: The Investigation
videos.overview: Tenali Rama is asked to investigate the disappearance of Tathacharya by Dhani and Mani. After much persuasion, Tenali Rama agrees and finds that Tathacharya was sedated and dragged. Meanwhile, Tathacharya is enjoying a sumptuous meal, unaware that he is about to be sacrificed.

videos.title: Saving Tathacharya
videos.overview: Pandit Rama gets to know about Tathacharya getting kidnapped and decides to save him so he follows his trail which leads him to the cave of the tribal people. The tribal people want to sacrifice Tathacharya in order to lift a centuries-old curse from their tribe. What will Pandit Rama do now?

videos.title: The Puppeteer
videos.overview: Dhani-Mani brings a puppeteer to Tathacharya who claims that he can plan an idea in a person's mind and can change the thinking process of a person using his puppets. Tathacharya brushes him off gives him a piece of his mind. But later Tathacharya realizes that there might be some truth to the puppeteer's claim and decides to use him against Pandit Rama.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Ploy
videos.overview: Kotwal and his wife arrive at the darbar with a problem. The Kotwal's wife has seen the puppeteer's act. Dhani and Mani inform Tathachaya that whoever has seen the puppeteer's act is mesmerized by it. Krishnadevaraya is intrigued and decide to call the puppeteer to the darbar. Unknown to Tenali Rama, Tathacharya joins hands with the puppeteer to humiliate Tenali Rama.

videos.title: The Puppet Show
videos.overview: Tathacharya plots against Pandit Rama and invites the puppeteer to the Darbar who claims that he can manipulate anybody's thoughts through his puppet show. After the puppet show is over, Maharaj Krishnadevraya gets influenced by the show and starts doubting Pandit Rama's intentions.

videos.title: Damage Is Done
videos.overview: The puppeteer's puppet show in the Darbar does the damage as Krishnadevraya gets deep in thoughts about the puppet show. Pandit Rama is worried about Krishnadevraya as he thinks that the show might have manipulated his thoughts. What will Krishnadevraya do now?

videos.title: Rama in Trouble
videos.overview: It went down exactly like Pandit Rama feared as Maharaj Krishnadevraya got so influenced and manipulated by the Puppeteer's show in the darbar that he is forced to kick Rama out of the darbar. Tathacharya's plan finally worked as Krishnadevraya insulted Rama in front of everyone in the court. What will Rama do now?

videos.title: The Letter
videos.overview: Pandit Rama is devastated after getting evicted from the court by Maharaj Krishnadevraya himself because of the effect of the puppet show so he decides to somehow make Maharaj realize his mistake and writes a love letter to the Orissa's Princess Jagan Mohini from Maharaj Krishnadevraya's side and invites her to Vijaynagar. What is Tenali's plan?

videos.title: The Invitation
videos.overview: Princess Jaganmohini comes to Vijayanagar and Maharani Chinnadevi and Maharani Tirumalamba are furious at her arrival so they decide to confront her. Sharda with Amma goes to the court to meet both the queens leaving Pandit Rama at home with Bhaskar.

videos.title: The Confrontation
videos.overview: Maharani Chinnadevi and Maharani Tirumalamba decide to confront Princess Jaganmohini and Maharaj Krishnadevraya as to who invited her to Vijayanagar. Maharaj himself is confused as on whose invitation did Jaganmohini came to Vijayanagar. So Jaganmohini decides to show them the invitation that Pandit Rama wrote. What will happen now?

videos.title: Caught Between the Wives
videos.overview: Trouble doesn't seem to calm down for Maharaj Krishnadevraya as his wives Maharani Chinnadevi and Maharani Tirumalamba continue doubting him for inviting Princess Jaganmohini to Vijayanagar after hearing about the love letters. Pandit Rama's plan to get back into the darbar. How?

videos.title: The Baby Thief
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya learns about a notorious baby thief. As no one has ever caught a glimpse of the theif, the council, especially Tenali Rama, are worried. Later, a mysterious woman named Bhajani Devi arrives at the darbar. What is the reason for the arrival of Bhajani Devi?

videos.title: The Invite
videos.overview: The news about the baby thief spreads like wildfire in the entire Vijayanagar and Krishnadevraya orders Mahamantri Ji to increase the security in the city. Bhajni Devi comes to the council and informs Maharaj about her Bhajan program where only women are invited. So Tathacharya goes there with Dhani-Mani disguised as a woman

videos.title: Almost Taken
videos.overview: Everything is in chaos in Vijayanagar as the news of babies being taken by the thief breaks out. Pandit Rama is worried about Bhaskar and the entire situation so Maharaj Krishnadevraya makes an important decision. The baby thief enters Pandit Rama's house to kidnap Bhaskar.

videos.title: Chaos at Midnight
videos.overview: At midnight, Tenali Rama makes the mistake of approaching Bhaskar. Amma and Shardha mistake him for the Baby Theif and thrash him. Shardha recognizes Tenali Rama's cries and rescues her from Amma's wrath. Later, Tenali Rama suspects that Bhajini Devi is the Baby Theif. Will Bhajini Devi get caught?

videos.title: Taking the Responsiblity
videos.overview: Tathacharya claims that Pandit Rama's focus to catch the baby thief might get hindered because of his genuine worry about his own son Bhaskar. Maharaj Krishnadevraya agrees to this and gives the responsibility to Tathacharya. Bhajni Devi gives Tathacharya a visit to manipulate his mind somehow.

videos.title: Attempt to Kidnap
videos.overview: Pandit Rama finds a clue against Bhajni Devi as he seriously believes that she is the baby theif but doesn't approach Maharaj with the clue as he wants to catch her red-handed. Bhajni Devi, with the help of Tathacharya and Dani-Mani attempt to kidnap Bhaskar and somehow pass the security and get into Pandit Rama's house.

videos.title: Undercover
videos.overview: Tattacharya reveals his identity after Krishnadevaraya announces punishment. Tenali Rama is rebuked as it is believed that the baby theif escaped because of him. Tenali Rama has a clue that should lead him to the theif. He decides to go undercover and visit Bhajini Devi to carry out his investigation.

videos.title: Bhaskar Goes Missing
videos.overview: The baby thief uses magic to create an illusion and fool Amma and Shardha. When Tenali Rama arrives, it is too late as Bhaskar has been taken by the baby theif. But, Tenali Rama has a plan up his sleeve to track the baby thief.

videos.title: The Thief Is Caught
videos.overview: Tenali Rama and Krishnadevaraya finally unravel the mystery behind the baby thief. The true face of Bhajini Devi is revealed and Tenali Rama rejoices that Bhaskar is safe. While Krishnadevaraya is all praise for Tenali Rama, Tathacharya is jealous that Tenali Rama is getting all the attention.

videos.title: Weight In Gold
videos.overview: After Pandit Rama saves the babies of Vijaynagar and is successful in capturing the baby theif with Bhaskar's help, Maharaj Krishnadevraya decides to present Bhaskar with his weight in gold coins. Pandit Rama accepts the prize but later distributes some of the gold coins among the poor of Vijaynagar.

videos.title: Exile
videos.overview: Pandit Rama distributes the gold coins that Maharaj Krishdevraya presented Bhaskar to the poor people in Vijayanagar and when Maharaj gets to know about this through Tathacharya, he feels insulted and is furious so as a punishment, he exiles Pandit Rama from Vijayanagar for three months. What will Rama do now?

videos.title: Pandit Rama's Plan
videos.overview: Pandit Rama believes that his intentions were not wrong when he distributed the gold coins given to him by Maharaj Krishnadevraya, among the poor so he decides not to serve the exile and stay inside his own house for three months. Sharda's brother Govind comes to visit them in Vijayanagar.

videos.title: The Protective Brother
videos.overview: Tenali informs his family including his brother-in-law, Govind to keep it a secret that he is still in Vijayanagar. Tathacharya's sister Ananta Lakshmi arrives at Vijayanagar whom Tathacharya is very protective of. Little do they know that Ananta Lakshmi and Govind's paths are about to cross.

videos.title: The Disguise
videos.overview: In order to hide his identity, Tenali Rama puts on a disguise. All hell breaks loose when Tenali Rama bumps into Tathacharya. Ananta Lakshmi falls from her palanquin. Govind turns a hero and saves Ananta from a serious fall. Now that Tathacharya has seen Tenali Rama, how will Tenali Rama find an escape route?

videos.title: Hide and Seek
videos.overview: Maharaj Krishnadevraya questions his own decision of sending Pandit Rama on an exile. Tathacharya helps in solving a problem and impresses Krishnadevraya. Tathacharya's sister Ananta along with Varunmala visit Pandit Rama's house to meet Bhaskar.

videos.title: A Gift
videos.overview: Maharaj Krishnadevraya receives a gift from the King of the neighboring kingdom whom he doesn't trust so he decides to reject the gifts but Tathacharya suggests that it might be a gesture of friendship and convinces him otherwise. Tathacharya and Dhani-Mani enter Pandit Rama's house at night to confirm that he is still in Vijayanagara.

videos.title: The Stolen Jewellery
videos.overview: Tathacharya sneaks into Tenali Rama's house at midnight but is caught by Shardha, and Tenali Rama, who disguises himself as Amma. Meanwhile, Krishnadevaraya has a new problem to deal with as Chinnadevi and Tirumalamba have been robbed of their precious jewelry.

videos.title: The Missing Crown
videos.overview: Govinda is adamant to revive Amma's voice and hear her speak. Tenali Rama has had enough of his brother-in-law and doesn't want him to interfere with Amma's vow. Meanwhile, Krishnadevaraya is woken up by a noise. Krishnadevaraya is shocked as his crown is missing. Has the crown been stolen?

videos.title: Chance at Redemption
videos.overview: Maharaj Krishnadevraya orders Mahamantri to tighten the security after the crown is stolen. Tathacharya informs Maharaj that Pandit Rama hasn't left Vijayanagara and is still hiding in his house so Maharaj goes to his house himself for inspection. Pandit Rama gets to know about the crown being stolen so decides to find the culprit and redeem himself.

videos.title: Night Guards
videos.overview: Pandit Rama sees the opportunity to redeem himself and decides to find the crown thief. Ananta tells Tathacharya that Govind might be able to help them find the crown so Tathacharya decides to sleep in the court at night with his family in order to guard the court. What will happen now?

videos.title: The Statue
videos.overview: Pandit Rama arrives in the darbar and claims that the theif is present inside the darbar. He asks Tathacharya to hit the statue at the midsection. The statue breaks and inside a box is found. What might be inside the box?

videos.title: Attack on Maharaj
videos.overview: Pandit Rama is woken up by a voice of a monster which scares him to the core. The voice tells him about a 'Tantrik' that will visit the court the next day and also tells Rama not to help the 'Tantrik'. Maharaj Krishnadevraya is attacked in the middle of the night by a scary looking guy.

videos.title: The Walking Dead
videos.overview: The Dead Body of the monster looking man from whom Maharani Tirumala Devi saved Maharaj Krishnadevraya, is kept in the court for inspection. Mahamantri, Tathacharya, and Pandit Rama inspect the situation but no one is able to find the identity of the man. Things go sideways when the dead man wakes up and attacks Maharaj Krishnadevaraya again.

videos.title: The Ominous Entity
videos.overview: An ascetic arrives at the darbar and informs about the ominous entity. The ascetic claims that he has captured the entity and reveals chilling details about the entity that leaves Krishnadevaraya shocked. Krishnadevaraya agrees to help the ascetic and asks Pandit Rama to carry out the task.

videos.title: Rama's Plea
videos.overview: The Deadman wakes up again and this time enters Pandit Rama's house and attacks him. He realizes that the dead man is attacking everyone who is helping the ascetic so he goes to the court to plead Maharaj Krishnadevraya not to help the ascetic.

videos.title: Catching the Demon
videos.overview: Maharaj Krishnadevraya ordered Pandit Rama to accompany the ascetic into the jungle and help him complete the process of catching the demon. So Pandit Rama goes to the jungle with the ascetic unknown to the dangers that await them.

videos.title: The Clever Poltergeist
videos.overview: Tenali Rama is organizing a ritual along with ascetic to ward off the poltergeist. Amma and Shardha arrive at the cave in search of Tenali Rama.  When they arrive, Tenali Rama presumes that they are poltergeists in human form.

videos.title: Saving Pandit Rama
videos.overview: After Pandit Rama disses off Shardha and Amma confusing them with the poltergeist, they both approach Maharaj Krishnadevraya and tells him everything. While the ascetic is sleeping, Pandit Rama gets out of the magic protection and just then Pralaynath arrives there. What will happen now?

videos.title: Saving Rama
videos.overview: Mahamantri and Kotwal find the ascetic lying in the jungle while looking for Pandit Rama. Later the ascetic tells Maharaj Krishnadevraya that Pralaynath has taken Pandit Rama into his captivity. Rama's family is devastated after hearing the news. Watch the episode to find out more.

videos.title: The Ghost of Tenali Rama
videos.overview: Tenali Rama's wandering spirit begins to haunt his family. Shardha and Amma are in fear when the poltergeist confronts them. Tathacharya too is in fear as he believes a spirit is following him. Has Tenali Rama really turned into a wandering spirit? Watch the episode and find out.

videos.title: The Haunting
videos.overview: Tenali Rama's ghost haunts Tathacharya in a bid to seek revenge. Rama's truth is revealed to Amma and Shardha, who learn that Tenali Rama is still alive. Then, Rama meets Krishnadevaraya, who presumes that it is the ghost of Tenali Rama that has come to meet him.

videos.title: Putting An End
videos.overview: Maharaj Krishnadevraya decides to put an end to the entire charade of the ascetic and Pralaynath so he asks the ascetic to perform the ritual in the court itself in front of everyone. Maharaj also announces a two day off to mourn the demise of Pandit Rama.

videos.title: The Unveiling
videos.overview: Pandit Rama and Maharaj Krishnadevraya's plan to unveil the mystery around the ascetic and Pralaynath as they themselves confess their crimes. The same night Pandit Rama has a dream about Devi Maa who informs Rama that she can't protect or stay in Vijayanagar anymore. Watch the episode to know more.

videos.title: Simpler Way
videos.overview: Pandit Rama tells Sharda about the dream he had the previous night. Maharaj Krishnadevraya comes to the court with a little girl and asks everyone to suggest solutions for the problem she's facing. Watch the episode to find out how Pandit Rama solves the little girl's situation giving everyone in the court a lesson.

videos.title: State Of Turmoil
videos.overview: Maharaj Krishnadevraya praises Pandit Rama in front of everyone in the court for him explaining to everyone how to celebrate Navratri in a simpler way. Later Maharaj wishes to circle around Vijayanagar to check if everything is going smoothly but when he sees the people deceiving each other in a state of turmoil it breaks his heart. Watch the episode to know more.

videos.title: Rama Loses His Mind
videos.overview: Everything seems to be going well for Pandit Rama while he completes the Navratri Puja but when he realizes that his dream has come true and Maa is actually leaving Vijayanagara, he starts to lose his mind. What will happen now? Will Pandit Rama be able to stop Maa from leaving? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: Devastated
videos.overview: Pandit Rama is devastated after Kaali Maa comes in his dream and tells him that she is leaving Vijayanagar. He goes to every temple to stop Maa from leaving. At last Pandit Rama goes to the court to tell this to Krishnadevraya. What will happen now? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: Pray To The Goddess
videos.overview: Pandit Rama is adamant in stopping the goddess from leaving Vijayanagara anyhow so he decides to worship her continuously until she stops. Tathacharya is furious at Rama for pushing him in the court in front of everyone so he locks Pandit Rama up in a house. Watch the episode to know more.

videos.title: Ending His Own Life
videos.overview: Pandit Rama somehow convinces the goddess to stay for another few minutes and have some food that he brought her but Pandit Rama has a plan to make the goddess stay there forever. Will his plan work out? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: Coming Back To Life
videos.overview: Everyone is devastated and mourns the death of Pandit Rama and blame themselves for not believing in him. Pandit Rama's soul tries to convince the goddess about his actions. Everyone goes bonkers when Pandit Rama actually comes back to life. Watch the episode to know more.

videos.title: Caught In The Act
videos.overview: Tathacharya catches his sister Ananta Lakshmi writing a love letter to Govind and this makes him furious. Ananta Lakshmi then goes to Pandit Rama's house and butter everyone in order to impress them. What will happen now? Watch the episode to know more.

videos.title: Rama Vs Tathacharya
videos.overview: Pandit Rama gets to know about Govind and Ananta's intention of getting married to each other so he decides to take a day off from the darbar but Tathacharya doesn't let it happen. Ananta Lakshmi keeps o trying to impress Shardha and Amma. Watch the episode to know more.

videos.title: Getting Out
videos.overview: Pandit Rama wants to get out of the Darbar and stop Ananta and Govind from getting along but Maharaj Krishandevraya gives him some work and keeps him there. Sharda and Amma witness Govind and Ananta getting close so they try to stop them. Watch the episode to know more.

videos.title: Locked Away
videos.overview: Pandit Rama decides to take responsibility on his shoulders to keep Ananta and Govind away so he decides to lock Govind away. But by mistake, he locks Ananta and Govind in the same room and throws away the key. What will happen now? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: Opening The Door
videos.overview: Govind and Ananta Lakshmi are locked together in a room and Pandit Rama is worried about Tathacharya finding it out. So tries to break the door as Amma has strictly instructed not to break the precious lock. What will Rama do now? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: Working Together
videos.overview: Pandit Rama and Tathacharya decide to work together in keeping Govind and Ananta apart despite their mutual dislike for each other so when the ceremony begins they are more eager to go through with the plan rather than focusing on the ceremony. Watch the episode to know more.

videos.title: Shubh Mangalam
videos.overview: Pandit Rama and Tathacharya want Ananta Lakshmi and Govind to stay away from each other. Tathacharya wants to get Ananta Lakshmi married and asks Dhani-Mani to inform Shubh Mangalam. Meanwhile, Govind informs Pandit Rama that he wants to marry Ananta Lakshmi. Will Tenali Rama agree for the marriage? Watch the episode and find out.

videos.title: Finding The Right Guy
videos.overview: Two cases of problematic marriages are received in the Darbar and both the marriages were set by Shubh Mangalam so Maharaj decides to call him in the Darbar and asks Pandit Rama to solve the issue. Tathacharya calls up Shubh Mangalam to his house to find a guy for his sister Ananta Lakshmi. Watch the episode to know more.

videos.title: Pandit Rama's Plan
videos.overview: Pandit Rama and Tathacharya, despite their mutual dislike for each other, come together and plan to keep Govind and Ananta Lakshmi away from each other. Shubh Mangalam brings the profile of a perfect guy for Ananta. Ananta Lakshmi, being frustrated with her brother seeks Shardha and Amma's help. Watch the episode to know more.

videos.title: Govind To The Rescue
videos.overview: The family of the potential groom comes to see Ananta Lakshmi at Tathacharya's house with Pancit Rama disguised as Shubh Mangalam to make sure everything goes according to the plan. But Ananta with Sharda and Amma have a plan of their own. What will happen now? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: The Oddity
videos.overview: Govind claims that he has married Ananta Lakshmi but Tenali Rama dismisses Govind's claim. Then, Tathacharya introduces Ananta Lakshmi to her prospective bridegroom. But, all is not right with this to-be bridegroom. Tenali Rama notices that the behavior of Ananta Lakshmi's suitor is odd. Watch the episode to find out more.

videos.title: The Wealthy Suitor
videos.overview: Ananta Lakshmi's suitor has a secret: he has night blindness. Tathacharya learns that Ananta Lakshmi's prospective bridegroom has lied to him and decides to cancel the marriage. But, Shubh Mangalam manages to convince Tathacharya that Ananta Lakshmi's suitor is wealthy. Hearing this, Tathacharya decides to get his sister married against her wishes. What will happen now to Govind and Ananta Lakshmi's love story? Watch the episode and find out.

videos.title: Exposing Shubh Mangalam
videos.overview: Pandit Rama realizes Govind and Ananta's love for each other and approaches Tathacharya to convince him for their marriage but Tathacharya refuses right away. So Pandit Rama decides to expose Shubh Mangalam and Naineshwar Rao's plan in the Darbar in order to convince Tathacharya. Watch the episode to know more.

videos.title: Tathacharya In A Loop
videos.overview: Pandit Rama informs Maharaj Krishnadevraya that its Tathacharya's 60th birthday the next month and according to the rituals Tathacharya wants to get remarried to his wife Varunmala so Maharaj announces a celebration of his birthday and their re-marriage. Everything seems to be going in Pandit Rama's favor till now but little does he know that a huge obstacle is about to come in his plan. Watch the episode to know more.

videos.title: Rama In Trouble
videos.overview: Dhani-Mani influence Saudamini and informs her about Tathacharya marrying Varunmala again so she tells Tathacharya that he should get married again, not to Varunmala but to her. Tathacharya gets to know about the fake love letter that Pandit Rama sent to Princess Jagan Mohini in the name of Maharaj Krishnadevraya. Watch the episode to find out what happens next.

videos.title: And The Blackmails Starts
videos.overview: Tathacharya finds out about Pandit Rama writing the love letter to Princess Jagan Mohini in Maharaj Krishnadevraya's name so he starts blackmailing Rama and makes him write another letter of the same sort and sends it to Jagan Mohini. What will happen now? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Ploy
videos.overview: Tathacharya keeps on blackmailing Pandit Rama and tells him to do something for him which is against Rama's ethics and values and which may result in him getting banished from Vijayanagara if Maharaj found out about it. Princess Jagan Mohini arrives in the Darbar and Maharani Chinna Devi and Maharani Tirumala Devi are clearly not happy about it. Watch the episode to know more.

videos.title: Turning The Tables
videos.overview: Tathacharya warns Pandit Rama to leave Vijayanagar within a fortnight or else he'll expose his secret to Maharaj Krishnadevraya so Amma and Sharda decide to turn the table on Tathacharya by playing the Soudamini Devi card. What will happen now? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: The Stage is Set
videos.overview: Anantha Lakshmi and Govind are strolling in the park when Govind unintentionally ends up injuring a man, whose intention is Tenali Rama's humiliation. Later, Pandit Rama calls the council members and informs them that they will be acting in the play. Then, Pandit Rama calls Govind and asks him to get ready for the play. What is Pandit Rama's intention behind organizing the play? Watch the episode and find out.

videos.title: One Act Play
videos.overview: The one-act play starts with Pandit Rama narrating the story and Govind & Ananta Lakshmi acting the scenes but Govind and Ananta Lakshmi go out of their characters and express their love for each other in front of the entire darbar which makes Tathacharya furious. What will happen now?

videos.title: Test of Love
videos.overview: Tathacharya finds himself in a tight spot after Pandit Rama asks him to find the real Varunmala in a series of her reflections. After Tathacharya clears the test, now it's Pandit Rama's turn to find Shardha and prove his true love. Unknown to Pandit Rama, a threat looms large on his life. Watch the episode to find out what happens next.

videos.title: Revenge
videos.overview: While the celebrations are underway, Pandit Rama calls Krishnadevaraya to the stage. The crowd goes silent when Jaganmohini is asked to find the real Krishnadevaraya in a series of his reflections. Thankfully, Krishnadevaraya is saved from humiliation when an attack on Pandit Rama creates panic in the crowd. Who is behind the attack on Pandit Rama?

videos.title: King's Command
videos.overview: Pandit Rama's attacker is captured, arrested, and sent to jail for the longest time. Tathacharya approaches Maharaj Krishnadevraya and asks him for justice after explaining how Pandit Rama ployed against him by involving his sister in his one-act play and making her act with Govind.

videos.title: The Twist in the Tale
videos.overview: Annacharya brother of Tathacharya arrived  with a a lot flair and servants. He has a surprise for his younger brother.  A surprise for Tatchacharya and bad news for Rama!

videos.title: The Doppelganger
videos.overview: Tathacharya's elder brother finds the Doppelganger of Pandit Rama and sends him to Tathacharya for his ploy to kick Pandit Rama out of Vijayanagar. Tathacharya plans to replace the real Pandit Rama with the fake one so he asks the real Rama to go on an exile for a month to suffer for his mistakes.

videos.title: A Bigger Conspiracy
videos.overview: Tathacharya sends Pandit Rama, Shardha, and their son on an exile for a month but on their way out of the city they are kidnapped by Pandit Rama's doppelganger. While they are kept in an isolated place, Pandit Rama eavesdrops on the kidnappers and gets to know their plan.

videos.title: Undetected
videos.overview: Sudhama confidently walks into the darbar. The council members fail to identify Pandit Rama's doppleganger. Pandit Rama and Shardha hope that either Krishnadevaraya or the Queens will identify the doppelganger but it doesn't turn out that way. Sudhama fools everyone and the wise men fall for it. What lies ahead for Pandit Rama?

videos.title: The Conspiracy
videos.overview: Pandit Rama learns that Sudhama has reached the palace undetected. Meanwhile, Sudhama shows that he isn't just a pawn in the hands of Tathacharya by settling a dispute. When Sudhama reaches Pandit Rama's house, he decides to eliminate Gundappa and Amma. Will Sudhama succeed in his plan?

videos.title: The Assassination Plot
videos.overview: Sudhama falls into his own trap, which he had laid for Amma and Gundappa. Pandit Rama pleads with the kidnappers to provide milk for Bhaskar but the kidnappers ask Pandit Rama to solve a puzzle first. After Pandit Rama solves the puzzle, the kidnapper puts a new challenge. If Rama wins he will be set free but he fails, he has to take the responsibility of Krishnadevaraya's murder.

videos.title: The Puzzle
videos.overview: Pandit Rama has the sole responsibility to Save Maharaj Krishnadevraya's life as the assassins are ready with their plans but first, he comes across a puzzle that he has to solve in order to get out of the captivity. On the other hand, Sudama is already in the Darbar laying the trap and planning the assassination.

videos.title: Failed Attempt
videos.overview: Sudama attempts to assassinate Maharaj Krishnadevraya but fails miserably and almost gets caught. Pandit Rama solves the last piece of the puzzle and escapes his kidnappers with Shardha and Bhaskar. But now the question arises, how will Pandit Rama unveil Sudama's true identity and save Krishnadevraya?

videos.title: Taken Over
videos.overview: Pandit Rama escapes his captors and reaches home only to find out that Sudama has taken over his life. Amma doubts that the person in her house eating the food is not actually Pandit Rama but an impersonator. Finally, Pandit Rama and Sudama come face to face.

videos.title: Escape Route
videos.overview: Tenali Rama asks Gundappa to escape through the hidden door and reach the palace. Gundappa is reluctant to step inside the dark tunnel but after Pandit Rama's words of bravery, Gundappa takes Bhaskar and enters the tunnel. Will Pandit Rama be able to prevent Krishnadevaraya's assassination?

videos.title: Conning the Conman
videos.overview: If Sudhama can pretend to be Pandit Rama, then what's stopping Pandit Rama from pretending to be Sudhama? That's what Pandit Rama does in this episode to find out what's Sudhama and Tathacharya are up to. But, Tathacharya gets a hint that Sudhama might be Pandit Rama and decides to find out.

videos.title: Life in Danger
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya's life is in danger and Pandit Rama is still unsure of the assassination plot. Pandit Rama and Maha Mantri team up to foil Sudhama's assassination attempt. Meanwhile, Annacharya humiliates Tathacharya in front of Krishnadevaraya. Tathacharya suspects that Annacharya is after his job. Will Sudhama succeed in assassinating Krishadevaraya?

videos.title: Rama Vs Sudhama
videos.overview: Will Sudhama and Annacharya succeed in their devious plan?

videos.title: The Fair Punishments
videos.overview: Shardha and Amma help Maharaj Krishnadevraya to reveal the real Pandit Rama by asking Sudhama and Pandit Rama questions which only Rama might know the answers to. After revealing the reveal Pandit Rama, Krishnadevraya asks him to give fair punishments to Annacharya, Tathacharya, and everyone who was involved in the conspiracy.

videos.title: The Special Counsel
videos.overview: Pandit Rama goes to the Darbar and gets to know about Maharaj Krishnadevraya's personal advisory team which doesn't include Pandit Rama so he feels neglected. Pandit Rama decides to write his knowledge and all the experience in a book and decides to gift it to Maharaj Krishnadevraya.

videos.title: Pandit Rama's Honor
videos.overview: Pandit Rama is determined to regain his lost honor. He spends day and night turning his thoughts and philosophies into words and pens it down. Then, Pandit Rama presents his work to Krishnadevaraya. Will Krishnadevaraya be impressed with the work?

videos.title: Meet Birbal
videos.overview: Pandit Rama is overwhelmed by the respect Krishnadevaraya has shown towards him. He feels that Tathacharya has played a vital role in his success. But, where is Tathacharya? Tathacharya is headed towards a pilgrimage and on the way, he meets Birbal. How will Tathacharya exploit the wit of Birbal?

videos.title: A Secret Message
videos.overview: Maharaj Krishnadevraya decides to add Pandit Rama in the highest orders of his advisory team. Later Maharaj receives a secret message encrypted in a language that is unknown so he gives it to Pandit Rama to solve it and get the meaning behind it. Tathacharya after meeting Birbal decides to bring him back to Vijaynagar and make him stand against Pandit Rama.

videos.title: Birbal To The Rescue
videos.overview: Pandit Rama spends a lot of time decoding the secret message but is not able to do that so Tathacharya enters the darbar with a solution that is Birbal. Birbal successfully decodes the message and impresses Krishnadevraya but then Tathacharya advice Maharaj to add Birbal to his high advisory ranks rather than Pandit Rama. What will happen now? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: Signs Of War
videos.overview: Pandit Rama and Birbal come together and use their intellect and decode the secret letter and warn Maharaj Krishnadevraya about a war on its way to Vijaynagar. Maharaj tells Mahamantri to ready the troops for the war but an immense problem stands in their way.

videos.title: A New Challenge
videos.overview: Tathacharya is jealous of Pandit Rama's accomplishments and has planned to humiliate him in front of Krishnadevaraya. Tathacharya questions Pandit Rama's laurels before Krishnadevaraya, forcing the king to contemplate Pandit Rama's credibility as his advisor. Krishnadevaraya decides to test Pandit Rama's wit against Birbal's brilliance. Will Pandit Rama be able to prove his worth?

videos.title: Test Of Knowledge
videos.overview: Maharaj Krishnadevraya announces a competition to test Pandit Rama and Birbal's wit and Knowledge and then make a decision as to who deserves to be added to the special counsel. Tathacharya plans to help Birbal win the competition and kick Pandit Rama out of the Darbar once and for all.

videos.title: Birbal Vs. Pandit Rama
videos.overview: The Seven Gurus have set up seven distinct challenges for Pandit Rama and Birbal and whoever successfully completes four of them will be the eight Guru in the court of King Krishnadevaraya. Both face off for the first task and have completed it. Who has won the first contest?

videos.title: And the Winner Is...
videos.overview: The battle of wits is becoming intense as Birbal wins the first round. Tathacharya is ecstatic that Pandit Rama has been defeated. Now, Pandit Rama has to prove his credibility in the second round. Who will win this round?

videos.title: Heaven or Hell
videos.overview: After Pandit Rama equalises in the battle of wits to become the eight Guru of Krishnadevraya's court, the third task is a challenge for both, Pandit Rama and Birbal. Pandit Rama attempts first for the answer. Will he choose the door to heaven or hell?

videos.title: Thinker's Game
videos.overview: After a scintillating battle of minds between Pandit Rama and Birbal, the battle of wits is being led by Birbal by 3-2 against Pandit Rama. The sixth challenge given by King Krishnadevraya is a tricky question. Will Pandit Rama be able to equalise or Birbal will become the eighth guru?

videos.title: The Final Task
videos.overview: Pandit Rama equalizes the battle of wits against Birbal and makes it 3-3, which brings them to their last stage of the battle of wits. The last challenge is presented by King Krishnadevraya to both Birbal and Pandit Rama. Who shall win the battle of wits to become the eighth guru?

videos.title: Emperor or Thief?
videos.overview: The last challenge is to catch the person who stole Vijaynagar's gold and Birbal and Pandit Rama decide to find the culprit with collective effort. The stolen gold is retrieved from the Emperor's custody. Who has framed the emperor and will he get caught?

videos.title: The Hunt of Thief
videos.overview: The collaborated effort from Birbal and Tenali is out to find the real thief but King Krishnadevraya has given the court three days to find out the real culprit otherwise he shall take all of the blame and be ready for the punishment. Birbal and Pandit Ramakrishna while interrogating the accused make a shocking discovery.

videos.title: Thief Caught!
videos.overview: After a lot of work and thinking put in by Birbal and Pandit Rama, after rounding up two suspects and both of them being innocent, the case is stuck again at square one. Suddenly, a clue strikes to Pandit Rama and he is set out to find the truth. Will they be able to catch the real thief?

videos.title: Tenali Rama - Going Home
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya is in a dilemma when it comes to choosing a winner between Birbal and Pandit Rama. Tathacharya vouches for Birbal and proclaims that the wise Birbal saved Vijayanagar from humiliation.

videos.title: The Truth of the Last Challenge
videos.overview: Everybody is trying to stop Pandit Rama but he is adamant on leaving. Also, Birbal realises that his victory was handed to him on a silver platter by Pandit Rama and he leaves to find the truth. Stay Tuned!

videos.title: The Eye-Opener
videos.overview: Birbal returns to Vijaynagar and calls for an emergency council meeting where he puts up the agenda to punish Pandit Rama for cheating the whole assembly of the minister and the king himself. What will happen next? Stay tuned!

videos.title: Pandit Rama Returns
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya orders his men to escort Pandit Rama back to Vijayanagar. A pompous celebration is organized in honor of Pandit Rama, who is escorted to Vijayanagar on a royal elephant.

videos.title: The Eighth Guru
videos.overview: Shaitaan Singh has come to Krishnadevraya's court and has challenged any warrior from Vijaynagar to step up and have a duel with him. Pandit Rama rushes and accepts the challenge. How will Pandit Rama get out of this situation? Stay tuned!

videos.title: Challenge for Duel
videos.overview: Shaitaan Singh has come to Krishnadevraya's court and has challenged any warrior from Vijaynagar to step up and have a duel with him. Pandit Rama rushes and accepts the challenge. How will Pandit Rama get out of this situation? Stay tuned!

videos.title: Warm-up
videos.overview: The king decides that Pandit Rama go through training for the battle. Will Pandit Rama be able to do it? Stay Tuned!

videos.title: A Full Plate for Pandit Rama
videos.overview: After Pandit Rama has accepted Shaitaan Singhs' challenge, he has taken up one more challenge of proving Deodas wrong. Deodas has accused his teacher, Acharya Chakrapani, that his teaching could not get them a job, hence he should return their fees.

videos.title: Rise to the Challenge
videos.overview: Pandit Rama is warned about the things to come by Amma, who fears the dreaded fight between Rama and Shaitan Singh. Pandit Rama also has to prove his worth against Devodas in front of the darbar. Will Pandit Rama rise to the challenge?

videos.title: Teacher's Importance
videos.overview: As the court gets ready for the case of Deodas against Acharya Chakrapani, Pandit Rama defends Acharya against all odds. Also, Tathacharya promises to take seven rounds of Vijaynagar and pray for Pandit Rama's victory. Stay Tuned!

videos.title: The Longest Sword
videos.overview: Pandit Rama is about to face Shaitan Singh and is wandering around for ideas helplessly. Shaitan's minions are trying to get an idea of what preparations Pandit Rama is up to.

videos.title: Pandit Rama Wins
videos.overview: Pandit Rama outsmarts Shaitan Singh and wins the battle. Shaitan Singh recognizes Pandit Rama as a brave warrior and bow downs to him. Meanwhile, Tathacharya is shocked that Pandit Rama has won the battle.

videos.title: For Nothing, This and That
videos.overview: In search of a new principal for the school which is going to start in Vijayanagar, Pandit Rama and Krishnadevraya are disguised as normal men and visit the market and also, solve the puzzle given to the king by the queen. Stay Tuned!

videos.title: Education is Power
videos.overview: The new Principal of the Gurukul is in Tathacharya's control due to his past. Tathacharya's motives of reserving the education imparted by the Gurukul to the Royal Prince' is challenged by Rama.

videos.title: Plan Flips
videos.overview: The man who was sent to kill Krishnadevaraya is all set to fire his arrow. Tathacharya is successful in using the magical powder on Pandit Rama. What will happen now? Stay tuned!

videos.title: Plan Flips
videos.overview: The man who was sent to kill Krishnadevaraya is all set to fire his arrow. Tathacharya is successful in using the magical powder on Pandit Rama. What will happen now? Stay tuned!

videos.title: Pandit Rama Is Honored
videos.overview: After Pandit Rama saves Krishnadevraya and catches the attacker, he asked to sleep by Tathacharya who has Pandit Rama under his magical spell. Post waking up, Pandit Rama is honored in the court.

videos.title: Gundappa's Test
videos.overview: Tathacharya gets another opportunity to trouble Pandit Rama when Gundappa's identity is revealed to Krishnadevaraya. Tathacharya announces that Gundappa will be allowed into the Gurukul only when he passes a test.

videos.title: Gundappa Clears the Test
videos.overview: Gundappa clears the test put forth by Tathacharya. A humbled Tathacharya learns how Gundappa managed to outsmart him. Now that Gundappa has been allowed to study at the Gurukul, Tathacharya ploys to make life difficult for him.

videos.title: Gundappa’s Obstacles
videos.overview: Pandit Rama gets suspicious of Tathacharya as he is following him. While at the Gurukul, Gundappa is rebuked for his actions by his teacher. Gundappa notices that he is being sidelined.

videos.title: Gundappa Survives
videos.overview: Vidyadhar, who on Tathacharya's orders, troubles Gundappa so that he leaves the gurukul but the advise given to Gundappa by Pandit Rama motivates him to fight the situation. Elsewhere, a guy has been sent by Vijaynagar's enemy for a specific task.

videos.title: Servant's Mishap
videos.overview: The servant who was appointed to Krishnadevraya, offers him water in the morning due to which the voice of Krishnadevraya is distorted and he orders the servant's arrest. Will Pandit Rama be able to save the servant? Stay tuned!

videos.title: New Challenge
videos.overview: Gundappa is finding it difficult to study at the Gurukul as his teacher is giving him a tough time. Meanwhile, a man named Siraj walks into the darbar and announces that he has a new challenge for Krishnadevaraya and his council members.

videos.title: A Bag of Coal
videos.overview: Krishnadevraya accepts Siraj's challenge, of selling a bag of coal to the most miser person in Vijaynagar, on behalf of Pandit Rama and on top of that Pandit Rama has to prove Adinath as not guilty. How will Pandit Rama face the challenge?

videos.title: Solving the Riddle
videos.overview: Tathacharya, Dhani, and Mani, having disguised themselves as beggars, arrive at Pandit Rama's house. Pandit Rama finds out that Tathacharya is in a disguise. Tathacharya asks a question to Pandit Rama.

videos.title: The Promise
videos.overview: Pandit Rama is tensed about the two promises he has made and not being able to fulfil any one of those. He is confident that he will solve those both problems but hasn't figured out a way to solve the problem.

videos.title: Pandit Rama's Disguise
videos.overview: Siraj asks Krishnadevaraya to accept his challenge as Pandit Rama is nowhere to be found. Then, Balachandru arrives at the court with a man named Seemanth Prasanna. The council members break into laughter following Balachandru's claims.

videos.title: Who Is More Sinister?
videos.overview: Adinath is set to be given death sentence on the accustion of being sinister and a representation of bad omen. Adinath blames Pandit Rama for his situation. Pandit Rama tell Adinath to express his last wishes and tells him something in private.

videos.title: Gundappa Confesses His Trouble
videos.overview: On being questioned by Sharda and Pandit Rama about his eating habits, they get to know that Maharishi Vidyadhar takes away his lunch everyday. Sharda plans a fix for the problem. Will the fix solve or increase Gundappa's trouble? Stay tuned!

videos.title: The Divine Gem
videos.overview: An ambassador from Chandrapur region named Sanchit Rao visits the Vijayangar court with a small problem i.e. he asks of Krishnadevraya to take care of a divine gem owned by the emperor of Chandrapur as Chandrapur is under siege.

videos.title: The Challenge
videos.overview: In this episode, Pandit Rama has to guard the jewel as well as impart some knowledge to Buddhi Das. Pandit Rama brings Buddhi Das to his house and takes help of Amma and Shardha to teach Buddhi Das.

videos.title: A Learned Buddhi Das
videos.overview: Pandit Rama after a lot of thinking and suffering has figured out a way to impart knowledge to Buddhi Das. A day later Pandit Rama presents himself in the court with Buddhi Das claiming that he has imparted the required knowledge to Buddhi Das.

videos.title: Losing His Eyes
videos.overview: After they discover in the court that the divine gem is lost, Sanchit Rao asks Krishnadevraya to fulfil his promise and give him his both eyes. Tathacharya pleads in front of Pandit Rama to save Krishnadevraya. What will Pandit Rama do? Stay tuned!

videos.title: Helplessness
videos.overview: Pandit Rama is feeling helpless as Krishnadevaraya is about to lose his eyes. Krishnadevaraya is ready to give his eyes but Pandit Rama announces that it is his eyes that should be sacrificed.

videos.title: Family Problem
videos.overview: A new type of problem has aroused in the court when, two men walk in and claim that they both have the same woman as wife. When the wife is asked about whom is she married to, she faints. What will happen next? Stay tuned!

videos.title: The Test Of Truth
videos.overview: When the two men and the female in the court battle out for who is the husband of the woman, Pandit Rama comes out with a test that defines who is the real husband, but the woman says that Abdullah has her son in custody. What will happen next?

videos.title: The New King
videos.overview: After the dream that came to Krishnadevraya, he has decided to swap places and resposibilites with Pandit Rama for the next three days. Pandit Rama has no choice but to become the king of Vijaynagar. What will happen next? Stay tuned!

videos.title: The Dream
videos.overview: As per the new terms, Pandit Rama has to stay in the palace while Krishnadevaraya will move into Pandit Rama's house. Tathacharya has a dream in which he sees Pandit Rama as the newly crowned king.

videos.title: The Throne
videos.overview: Pandit Rama arrives in the palace with his family to take over as the new King of Vijayanagar. Krishnadevaraya vacates the palace and moves into Pandit Rama’s house until Pandit Rama serves as the king.

videos.title: Other Side Of The Table
videos.overview: Now that Pandit Rama and Krishnadevraya have exchanged their positions both are getting to know what is the responsibilty of one another and face the day to day challenges which occur in each others life. What will it lead to? Stay tuned!

videos.title: The New Challenge
videos.overview: A man walks into the darbar and puts forth a challenge before Pandit Rama. As per the new challenge, Pandit Rama has to gain mastery over wind.

videos.title: Krishnadevraya's Confusion
videos.overview: On one hand where Pandit Rama is tensed about what to about the businessmen association's strike, Krishnadevraya life's in turmoil where he is unable to figure out the solution to the problem of controlling the wind.

videos.title: The Most Religious Man
videos.overview: After the problem of the business association is solved by Pandit Rama, the new task at hand for the interim king is to determine the most religious man in Vijaynagar. Krishnadevraya suggests that someone should represent the court as well!

videos.title: Tathacharya's Displeasure
videos.overview: Tathacharya creates a ruckus in the darbar and proclaims that Pandit Rama is not the king. Tathacharya and the council members disagree with Pandit Rama's decision and raise their voice against Pandit Rama.

videos.title: All's Well If Ends Well
videos.overview: After all the fuss is cleared Pandit Rama and Krishnadevraya understand the importance of their own positions in the court and praise each other for all their efforts. Sugandha Devi tell Pandit Rama…

videos.title: Krishnadevraya's Third Marriage
videos.overview: Krishnadevraya's so called sister has come up with the marriage of her neice Sugandha Devi with Krishnadevraya. He denies getting married again and also asks Sugandha Devi about what she wants and she wants to get married to Pandit Rama.

videos.title: Pandit Rama In Trouble
videos.overview: Krishnadevraya tells Pandit Rama that Sugandha Devi has chosen Pandit Rama as her prospect husband and would like to live in Pandit Rama's house with his family for a few days. Pandit Rama is not at all happy with this news and is scared

videos.title: Pandit Rama’s Marriage
videos.overview: Sugandha arrives in Pandit Rama’s house and is met with hostility. Shardha, believing that Pandit Rama is marrying Sugandha, cries inconsolably. Pandit Ram.

videos.title: Pandit Rama's Fate
videos.overview: Though Shardha isn't impressed with Sugandha initially, slowly things turn around and Sugandha manages to impress not only Shardha but also Amma.

videos.title: A Chance To Impress
videos.overview: The King and his royal guest are heading to Tenali's place for a feast. While Sugandha starts prepping up the meal for the evening, Shardha and Amma, keep holding to the thought of Tenali ending up with Sugandha. Watch the full episode now!

videos.title: Marriage Proposals
videos.overview: Shardha realizes her mistake and tries to get the wedding canceled but it is too late as Krishnadevaraya wants to stick to the terms and conditions of the marriage and orders that Pandit Rama and Sugandha's wedding take place as planned.

videos.title: Test of Love
videos.overview: Bagdhatta, Pushpavati, and Snehalata arrive in the darbar to meet Krishnadevaraya. Bagdhatta is in a dilemma as he is unsure who he should marry, Pushpavati or Snehalata. Krishnadevaraya asks Pandit Rama to solve this issue.

videos.title: The Tragedy
videos.overview: The day of the wedding has arrived. Tathacharya goes looking for Pandit Rama as everyone is awaiting his presence. But, Pandit Rama is found in an unconcious state by Tathacharya.

videos.title: Meet Narayan Krishna
videos.overview: Shardha is relieved after finding that Pandit Rama is alive. While on the streets on the darbar, Pandit Rama comes across Narayan Krishna's, a neighbouring king, palanquin.

videos.title: Demands
videos.overview: After Krisnadevraya introduces Nayaran Krishna to the court, Narayan Krishna tells Krishnadevraya that he needs his help as he lost all his savings in gambling. Pandit Rama takes the opportunity of suggesting the help Narayan Krishna should recieve,

videos.title: The Humble Guest
videos.overview: Tathacharya is intrigued to find a cow in the darbar. The curiosity soon turns into shock when Tathacharya finds that Pandit Rama has brought the cow in the darbar.

videos.title: A Changed Man
videos.overview: Pandit Rama proves his point before Krishnadevaraya and helps Narayan Krishna realise his mistake. Narayan Krishna is a changed man after this experience and decides to leave gambling for good. Meanwhile, a new situation has arisen in Vijayanagar.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Greed
videos.overview: Tathacharya comes to know about the miraculous appearance of an idol on a piece of land. Tathacharya decides to use this situation to his advantage by getting a grand temple constructed on the site.

videos.title: Inaugration Of The New Land
videos.overview: Everyone is furious about Tenali Rama again being late to the meeting. Baba Moorthi Anand informs Maharaja that he will have to inaugrate the temple built on the new found land. Tenali Rama informs him that the land belongs to the farmer Srikanth.

videos.title: The Crow Attack
videos.overview: Pandit Rama has a strange dream in which he sees everyone speaking in different animal sounds. Soon after Pandit Rama wakes up, strange things start happening in Vijayanagar. A murder of crows starts attacking people randomly.

videos.title: Crows Causing A Menace
videos.overview: Tenali as usual is late to the darbar and as soon as he enters he requests for a leave today which is granted by the Maharaja causing unhappiness to Tathacharya. Crows cause a menace now for the Guruvar. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: Tathacharya Attacked
videos.overview: Tatchacharya explains Dhani Mani how he manipulated everyone against Pandit Ramakrishna by blaming him for killing a crow. At the same time a crow comes and sits in front of Tathacharya which scares him and is then attacked by the bunch of crows.

videos.title: Yogya To Scare Crows
videos.overview: The crows are wreaking havoc in the town. They came into the palace to challenge the king and warn him to leave Vijayanagara. Tathacharyya’s instant solution is to organise an Yogya and satisfy the ancestors.

videos.title: Terror Of Crow
videos.overview: As Maharaj is doing hawan to get rid with the crows and suddenly lots of crows attacked. Everybody gets scared. Tenali trying to reach where hawan is going on

videos.title: Crow's Den
videos.overview: While the villagers of Vijaynagar are affraid that they might have to leave their village beacause of the crow attack, Maharaja promises them that he would fight this challenge and win for his people. Tenali follows the group of crows into a den.

videos.title: The End Of Bad Times
videos.overview: While the villagers of Vijaynagar are affraid that they might have to leave their village beacause of the crow attack, Maharaja promises them that he would fight this challenge and win for his people. Tenali follows the group of crows into a den.

videos.title: Translation
videos.overview: The task at hand for Pandit Rama is to translate five epics which are written in telegu and sanskrit by Krishnadevraya himself, that too in a months time. The king asks Tathacharya to help him with his endevours. Stay tuned!

videos.title: Everything Is In The Name
videos.overview: The stranger who entered Vijaynagar unknowingly starts fooling everyone. He tastes and eats sweets from the vendors and does not pay them back. He gets caught by the Mantri and is taken to the palace for punishment.

videos.title: Mullah Nasruddin Challenges Krishna Dev Rai
videos.overview: In this episode, Mullah Nasruddin challenge Krishna Dev Rai and Tenalirama. Mullah Nasruddin asked a few puzzles and told them to solve

videos.title: A Grant
videos.overview: Tenali invests time in completion of translation, while acharya focuses on wasting his time to put him in a troublesome situation.

videos.title: Naseeruddin Spills Food On Tathacharya
videos.overview: Rajaram is happy seeing Ramakrishna and takes him to his palace. He then asks Ramakrishna to write something about his village Vijaynagar as there is no history written about it. Naseeruddin comes over to have a meal with Tathacharya.

videos.title: Ramakrishna Solves The Riddle
videos.overview: Dhani-Mani make fun of Tathacharya's helplessness after Naseeruddin takes his case. Ramakrishna is muddled trying to find an answer to Naseeruddin's riddle. He starts dancing when he finds the answer in the middle of the night

videos.title: Naseeruddin Challenges Tathacharya
videos.overview: Naseeruddin asks Krishnaraja to let Tathacharya and Kotwal prove their genius in the court. He then presents a riddle in front of them and asks both of them to solve it by the next morning.

videos.title: The Biggest Thing In The World
videos.overview: After Naseeruddin has asked Tathacharya to find out the biggest thing in the world, Tathacharya with Dhani and Mani is out to figure out the answer to it and goes to Pandit Rama's house for help. Stay tuned!

videos.title: Ramakrishna Impresses Everyone
videos.overview: Ramakrishna solves Naseeruddin's riddle in the court and leaves everyone impressed. Naseeruddin is mind-blown when Ramakrishna makes him meet his look-alike.

videos.title: Bandhu At Stake
videos.overview: Pandit Ramakrishna accepts his defeat in the court. Naseeruddin asks Rama to present his ponytail and Krishnadevraya's moustache as per the bet. How will Rama handle this situation? Watch the episode and find out.

videos.title: Mullah Naseeruddin's Complaint
videos.overview: Mullah Naseeruddin visits Pandit Ramakrishna's home. Amma tells Ramakrishna that it's been 2 days since Naseeruddin has been in Vijayanagar and he didn't invite him to his place.

videos.title: Amma And Sharda In A Fix
videos.overview: Ramakrishna loses his mind as soon as Mullah Naseeruddin leaves his house. He makes it clear that he won't be helping Amma or Sharda to solve their riddle as he is busy finding an answer to his. As expected, Amma and Sharda come to Rama for help.

videos.title: Tenali Rama Answers The Riddle
videos.overview: King Krishna Debray gets very happy with Tenali Rama as he answered the riddle given by Mulla Naseer-u-din. But Tenali's mother and wife goes to the magical parrot to get the solutions of the riddles given to them.

videos.title: Mullah Naseeruddin Gets All His Answers
videos.overview: When Tenali Rama's mother and wife are presented at the King's court to answer the questions asked by Mullah Naseeruddin after so many thoughts they both answer correctly and hence get appreciated as well.

videos.title: Tenali Saves His Ponytail
videos.overview: In the court of King Krishnadebray, when Mulla Naseer was about to cut the beloved hair of Tenali Rama but he answers his riddle immediately and saves his hair from getting cut down.

videos.title: Farewell To Mullah Naseeruddin
videos.overview: The King and the courtiers along with Tenali Rama bid farewell to Mullah Naseeruddin and gift him much wealth and presents. Mullah as well is happy and appreciate the hospitality of Vijayanagara.

videos.title: Tathacharya Gets Terrified
videos.overview: While Tathacharya is in deep sleep and suddenly his eyes open, he sees a person he doesn't know and gets terrified. Later he introduces himself as Siddhasen and clarifies the doubt of Tathacharya.

videos.title: Rama Against Siddhasen
videos.overview: Pandit Ramakrishna suggests Siddhasen returns next year for the competition as he hasn't taken part this year. Tathacharya in order to make Rama look cruel, insists that Siddhasen is allowed to join the other musicians.

videos.title: Tenali Rama Enters Saudamini's House
videos.overview: After not getting allowed into Saudamini's house, Tenali Rama plans to enter into her house by being dressed as a lady. He tries to investigate the matter but fails and even just escapes away from being caught.

videos.title: Sharda Doubts Tenali Rama
videos.overview: While Tenali Rama was in deep sleep, suddenly his wife, Sharda enters into his room and finds a ladies dress below Tenali's bed. And as obvious she doubts Tenali and says she had seen a lady entering his room.

videos.title: Siddhasen Troubles Tenali Rama
videos.overview: While Tenali was going on his way to somewhere, Siddhsen asked him to get himself a broom with a witty smile. Tenali gets puzzled and doesn't get what exactly his intention was. And on the other side, King gets troubled by his queens.

videos.title: Tenali Rama Exposes Siddhasen
videos.overview: Tenali Rama challenges Siddhasen for cloaking the drum where he gets exposed that he was cheating others and Tenali reveals the whole secret behind the matter. He asks for forgiveness to king and Tenali as well asks for mercy to him.

videos.title: Sheikh Chilli
videos.overview: When Pandit Rama is out to have food from the eatry near the city, he sees the owner of the place tells his servant to take care of the work and he mentions the example of Sheikh Chilli to which Pandit Rama is excited to hear.

videos.title: In Your Dreams
videos.overview: Sheikh Chili is found by Tenali Rama continuously rambling on in the streets in an unconscious state. They get into an argument about the interpretation of his dreams. Sharda is also absent from their home which leaves Tenali very puzzled.

videos.title: Sheikh Chilli's Challenge
videos.overview: Sheikh Chilli is again daydreaming and he is influencing people of Vijayanagar as well to daydream with him. Tenali asks Sheikh Chilli to stop but people of Vijaynagar tell him not to stop Sheikh Chilli because they like what he is doing.

videos.title: A Set Of Questions
videos.overview: A man comes into the court of the king of Vijaynagar and declares that he has heard of the wisdom in this place and would like to pose to them some questions for which the court can try to answer. Stay tuned to find out more on Tenali Rama.

videos.title: The Shiekh's Trickery
videos.overview: Sheikh Chili is back with his antics in this episode and he is able to convince Tathacharya and his group to give him their riches. Tenali reaches their home to find them in a dream-like trance. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: The Sleepy Kingdom
videos.overview: Emperor Krishnadevaraya wakes up in a state of confusion in his chambers to find everyone in a sleepy trance. Tenali too wakes up to find his wife and mother in the trance and also discovers more than half the city in this condition.

videos.title: Sheikh Chili Exposed
videos.overview: The emperor and Tenali Rama come up with a plan to expose Sheikh Chilli as a fraud in front of his believers. They tell him that if his powers are true then he could survive being thrown into a fire. Watch what happens next on this episode.

videos.title: The Missing Bowl
videos.overview: Sharda is feeling hysterical and searching for her golden bowl. Deep in the jungle, a mysterious creature is holding the bowl, and commanding an army of monkeys. Back in Tenali's home, he is getting ready to go search for the thief.

videos.title: A Bunch Of Thieves
videos.overview: Tenali Rama once again foils the plans of Tathacharya to prank him by exchanging the bowls they are drinking from while he distracts the latter. The monkeys are running wild all over the city and stealing and eating all the fruits and sweets.

videos.title: Assembly In The Court
videos.overview: There is an assembly going on in the court of king Krishnadevaraya where two citizens have brought their complaints and Tenali gives a solution to their problems.

videos.title: The Gems
videos.overview: Queen Chinnadevi's parents have sent eight special gems to the royal court of Vijayanagar. According to her, these gems give out positive vibes once in every 12 years. Now the question is who shall be responsible to take care of the gems. Stay tuned

videos.title: Creating Mischief
videos.overview: The Kotwal comes to Tenali asking for a solution to his problems. The problem of the mysterious 'thieves' is still troubling the citizens of Vijayanagara. A strange turn of events causes Tathacharya to suspect Tenali of adultery.

videos.title: Missing Gems
videos.overview: Tenali Rama is deeply troubled because the treasure of the emperor has gone missing from his house. Tathacharya is in a deep sleep unable to be woken by his disciples. He wakes up to find the gems missing.

videos.title: Accused Of Stealing
videos.overview: In the court of emperor Krishnadevaraya, The case of the missing gems is still being discussed and Tenali is accused by Tathacharya because the former's gems have been found.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Solution
videos.overview: Tathacharya gives his solution to all the recent problems to which everyone in the court is scratching their heads. When Tenali speaks up against this plan, Tathacharya is furious. Inside his own mind, he continuous his private campaign.

videos.title: The Reason Why
videos.overview: Tenali comes up with a brilliant plan to trap the thief with the help of some chickpeas and a container. Things don't go according to plan, however, when hundreds of the thief's friends come to rescue him. The king is informed of this. Stay tuned

videos.title: Face Off With The Enemy
videos.overview: After everyone gets trapped by the monkeys, Pandit Rama thinks of a plan to save the king and in doing so, the leader of the monkey's goes unconscious. Will they save him or let him be. Stay tuned!

videos.title: Two Steps Ahead
videos.overview: Pandit Rama gets himself prepared for the challenge to be presented in the court of King. But Tathacharya is shocked after knowing that Rama is two steps ahead of him. Can Rama win the challenge? Stay tuned!

videos.title: Couple's Fight
videos.overview: There is a scene happening in the court of Vijayanagara- a couple brings their problems to the king and explains the situation. Tenali is able to figure out what really is happening behind the scene of the story they are telling.

videos.title: As You Sow, So You Reap
videos.overview: The emperor Krishnadevaraya is meeting with envoys from other states when an old man comes pleading for help from him-his son has left him to be by himself. When the son is brought to the meeting, he says that he has only done what his father had done

videos.title: Tenali's Wisdom Is Rewarded
videos.overview: Pandit Rama is being praised for his wisdom and wit by all. He is being put to the test with questions and puzzles. Tathacharya embarrasses himself by replying to them with the wrong answers.

videos.title: Pandit Ramakrishna Solves A Challenge
videos.overview: Mahamantri rolls the dice and faces a difficult question put up by King Ripu Daman, Pandit Ramakrishna asks Ripu Daman if he can answer the question of Mahamantri's behalf. Ripu Daman agrees.

videos.title: Incredible Throne
videos.overview: In order to save King from the mysterious woman Chitrangada, Tenali challenges her of returning her the money she had distributed among the general people of Vijaynagar.

videos.title: Tenali Figures The Business Man's Strategy
videos.overview: Chitrangada visits Vijayanagar to return back the money that her parents had taken as a loan from Krishnadevaray's parents. When Krishnadevaray doesn't accept the money Tathacharya tries to…

videos.title: Chitrangada Visits Vijayanagar
videos.overview: Chitrangada visits Vijayanagar to return back the money that her parents had taken as a loan from Krishnadevaray's parents. When Krishnadevaray doesn't accept the money Tathacharya tries to…

videos.title: Chitrangada's Black Magic
videos.overview: Chitrangada is with Tathacharya and he thinks of her as the key to unlocking his fortune. Wherever she walks, the people around her are affected by a different aura carried by her.

videos.title: Chitrangada Choses Someone To Marry
videos.overview: Men in the court of King Krishnadevaray fight with each other because all of them want to marry Chitrangada. Tathacharya intervenes and tells everyone Chitrangada will marry whoever she…

videos.title: Plan Successful
videos.overview: In order to save King from the mysterious woman Chitrangada, Tenali challenges her of returning her the money she had distributed among the general people of Vijaynagar.

videos.title: Plan Successful
videos.overview: The challenge with Chitrangada is underway and Pandit Rama and Tathacharya wait near the city market where people come and return whatever they got from Chitrangada.

videos.title: Angry King Krishnadevaray
videos.overview: Krishnadevaray is angry on the kid because he wants to sit on the throne and when Krishnadevaray denies his request, the kid tells him that he has a small heart. Tenali gets tensed looking…

videos.title: King Gets Irritated
videos.overview: n this episode, when Tenali Rama reaches the castle finds two queens in trouble and asks them if King knows the same. And to his surprise, he finds that the things happening is due to the…

videos.title: The Obstinate King
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya is laughed at by a courtesan when he tries to lift weights. A hot-headed king makes her dance till the last beat of the drum. Tattacharya opposes this and gets humiliated.…

videos.title: Tathacharya Is Awarded Death Penalty
videos.overview: Tathacharya refuses to apologise to the king following which he is punished with a death penalty. Tenali is clueless. What will he do now? Stay tuned!

videos.title: Tathacharya Reunites With The King
videos.overview: Tenali, finally succeeds in convincing Tathacharya to apologise to the king. Tathacharya and Krishnadevaraya reunite happily but perils for the Vijayanagar kingdom is yet to be dealt with.

videos.title: Tenali Impresses The King
videos.overview: Krishnadevaraya proves his strength against an intruder by virtue of Tenali's wit. He then realises the importance of Tenali in his life and hence everything falls into place in the kingdom.

videos.title: Tathacharya Is Insecure
videos.overview: The king organizes a function to pay homage to Tenali for his contributions. An envious Tathacharya tries to belittle Tenali by viciously rejecting his interpreted documents which need to be presented…

videos.title: Pandit Rama Is Honored
videos.overview: King Krishnadevraya is excited about honoring Pandit Rama in his court and he presents the seal which is going to be presented to Pandit Rama. But, unfortunately, the court is interrupted.…

videos.title: Tenali Proves Himself
videos.overview: Tathacharya tries to downgrade Tenali when Tenali fails to present the interpreted documents in the court. Tenali proves his calibre when Tathacharya's wife comes to his rescue.

videos.title: Krishnadevaraya Has An Idea
videos.overview: Seeing the promptness of one of his queens in the court, the king now seems to have realized the importance of women in society. He is helped by Tenali in a smart way.

videos.title: Krishnadevaraya Is Missing
videos.overview: Queen Tirummalam  gets a dream in which  she prepares food for King Krishnadevaray. When he eats the food prepared by Queen, he vanishes. Queen Chinnadevi is worried because King Krishnadevaray is nowhere to be found in the palace.

videos.title: Queens Become Rulers
videos.overview: Following the missing case of Krishnadevaray, the queens of Vijayanagar kingdom assume the responsibilities of the king and continue with the rituals of assuming the throne.

videos.title: The Magician's Challenge
videos.overview: A magician comes to the court and challenges everyone present to outsmart him with wit. Tenali accepts the challenge and succeeds in defeating the magician. Stay tuned to know!

videos.title: Women Empowerment
videos.overview: The queens of the Vijayanagar empire appoint Tathacharya's wife as the finance minister. Tathacharya is hesitant but Tenali explains the potential of women in every sector.

videos.title: Women In The Court
videos.overview: Queen Tirumalama orders all the men to leave the court as only women should rule now. They then get a complex civil case which leaves them pondering.

videos.title: Decision Of The Queens
videos.overview: Tenali warns both the queens from taking any harsh decisions. Both the queens let foreigners trade in Vijaynagar going against Tenali's suggestion. Queens decide that the court timing needs to be changed and adjusted as per the comfort of women in the court.

videos.title: Chinese Traders
videos.overview: Tathacharya's greed takes him to one of the chinese traders in the kingdom. They trade with Tathacharya in the intent to usurp the kingdom. Meanwhile, people in the court are unhappy with the royal court.

videos.title: Courtier's Opinions
videos.overview: Finally in the result day, whether to allow the foreign trader to settle in Vijaynagar, Queens decide to take the opinions of all courtiers for the final result. What will be the result?

videos.title: Low-Quality Goods
videos.overview: People in the kingdom come to know that the Chinese traders are fooling them by selling low-quality goods at an affordable price. The queens also realize the same and determine to teach foreigners a lesson.

videos.title: Tenali Sues Foreigners
videos.overview: Tenali proves in the court that the chinese traders who have fooled the people of Vijayanagar have to compensate for the losses. He seizes the permission letter that the traders had obtained from the queens.

videos.title: Krishnadevraya Disguises Himself
videos.overview: King Krishnadevraya disguises himself as a weapon trader and comes to the court in front of the queens. He proposes a business offer to them which will test their decision-making capabilities.

videos.title: Competition In Vijayanagar
videos.overview: Tenali proposes a contest where the male folks of the kingdom will take part and prove their potential. The queens also agree to it while Krishnadevaray, who has disguised himself also participates.
