videos.title: Men Put To Test
videos.overview: Amid the ongoing contest where Vijayanagar's men need to prove their caliber, Tenali suspects Krishnadevaraya's identity at a point where Krishnadevaraya tells him something familiar. Tathacharya and other men are also toiling hard in the contest.

videos.title: Gold Coins For The Contestants
videos.overview: Both the queens announce the winners of the second round and tell them that the winners will be awarded gold coins from the state. Queens tell the contestants about the next round where the contestants will be asked a question which has seven answers.  .

videos.title: Tenali Is Tensed
videos.overview: Mani, a disciple of Tathacharya abandons him and takes shelter in Tenali's home as his disciple. Tathacharya is enraged and Tenali is worried about the consequences.

videos.title: Mulla Nasruddin's Arrival
videos.overview: Mulla Nasruddin along with Prince of Tehran arrive in Vijaynagar and Queens decide them to stay at the castle to make it pleasurable but they refuse the offer. On the other hand, Tathacharya decides to take the responsibility of the guests.

videos.title: Krishnadevaray Reveals His Identity
videos.overview: Krishnadevaray reveals his identity and tells the queens that he did all of this to test both of them. Tathacharya apologizes to Krishnadevaray for his rude behavior. Krishnadevaray tells everyone that he has no idea about the letter from the Jaipur king, queens tell Krishnadevaray that this letter was written by them only.

videos.title: Mulla Nasruddin Tests Tenali
videos.overview: Mulla Nasruddin carefully observes Tathacharya stumbling on a dillapidated bridge. Seeing the weight limit of the bridge, he dares Tenali to cross the bridge carrying a rock in each hand.

videos.title: The Puzzle
videos.overview: After Tenali is put to test by Mulla Nasruddin, Krishnadevaray confirms that Tenali can pass any test. In the court, queens and Tenali try to solve Mulla Nasruddin's puzzle. Keep watching to know!

videos.title: Tathacharya's Conspiracy
videos.overview: Tathacharya makes a plan to remove Tehran's Prince from Vijaynagar with the help of his follower. But he makes a mistake by throwing them into Tathacharya's bed. What's the plan of Tathacharya?

videos.title: Ramakrishna Is Imprisoned
videos.overview: Pandit Ramakrishna and Mullah Nassruddin challenge the intelligence of the Kings. The Kings, however, shock the court and order for the imprisonment of the two intelligent people. They meet a plotting thief in the jail who is planning something big.

videos.title: Krishnadevarya's Wrong Decisions
videos.overview: While Mullah Naseeruddin and Tenali are behind the bars they discuss the judicial status of Vijaynagar. Tenali tells Mullah Naseeruddin that something has happened to King Krishnadevray, he is taking decisions in a jiffy and ruining everything for Vijaynagar.

videos.title: Pandit Rama In Disguise
videos.overview: Pandit Ramakrishna along with Mullah Nasruddin goes to the village of the beggars. They are disguised as beggars themselves and are searching for the house where the treasure is hidden. Both of them get caught in the process and their lives are in danger.

videos.title: Saudamini Denies To Marry Emperor Mustafa
videos.overview: Saudamini is ready to leave with the Emperor. However, she wants to get gifts for Mustafa's family. Mustafa asks her to get 36 Burkhas for his wives. This is when Saudamini learns that Emperor Mustafa has 36 wives already and engages in polygamy.

videos.title: Bhaskar Is Lost
videos.overview: Rama's son Bhaskar is at the palace and the queens are taking proper care of the child. Rama and his family go to the palace when Bhaskar tries to escape the palace. The king gets to know of the incident and everyone is searching for the kid.

videos.title: Bhaskar Grows Up
videos.overview: Rama shows his utter concern for his son and sleeps on the floor with him. He promises to love Bhaskar so much that it would become a yardstick for other parents. Bhaskar is growing up and is now six years old.

videos.title: Bhaskar And Friends Play A Prank
videos.overview: Bhaskar and his friends play a prank on Guruvar and this makes him furious. Guruvar makes sure he catches the escaping kid and brings him to the king. Guruvar accuses Bhaskar of trying to kill him.

videos.title: Tathacharya In Distraught
videos.overview: Bhaskar and his friend break into Tathacharya's house after fooling Dhani and Mani. They mischievously pull Tathacharya's dhoti's knot and run away. Tathacharya is disappointed and takes the matter to the court.

videos.title: Bhaskar Owns UP
videos.overview: Tenali scolds Bhaskar and asks him to quit his mischievous acts. He punishes him by giving him few nails to hammer down on the wall of his home. Each nail for every deed he committed. Meanwhile, Tathacharya is happy and wishes to treat himself with good food.

videos.title: Balakumar Is Bored
videos.overview: Today is an auspicious day for Tenali and his son Bhaskar as it was Bhaskar's Upnayanam. They both get up early and get ready for the puja. Meanwhile, Balakumar is getting bored in the palace and gets irritated by the servants.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Real Test
videos.overview: Tathacharya begins tutoring Balakumar with some simple mathematical problems, but Balakumar is unable to answer them. Tathacharya is getting frustrated with the dumbness of Balakumar, but he knows very well that he can't do anything about it.

videos.title: Questions Against Gods
videos.overview: Maharaj Krishnadevray enters the court to get updates about his kingdom. After a while, the court session begins. A young lady walks in with her disabled parents. She raised a question against the Gods of all religions and asked for justice. The entire court gets silent.

videos.title: Bhaskar's Life Is In Danger
videos.overview: Pandit Ramakrishna falls and hurts his knee. However, he manages to return home. The real bad news comes when he is at home. Bhaskar had gone to the riverside to get mangoes for his father. He falls from the tree and his life is in danger.

videos.title: Existence Of God
videos.overview: There is a debate as to whether or not there is God. Enters Pandit Ramakrishna and he also says that there is no God. However, then he explains how his son went through a life-threatening issue and still got through it. In time Pandit Ramakrishna explained how God takes care of all of us.

videos.title: Bhaskar Does Not Wanna Go
videos.overview: Ramanuj couldn't repay the loan in time to Venkatesh and the court is discussing this issue. Meanwhile, Bhaskar does not wanna go back to Gurukul and wants his mother to convince Tenali. In the meantime, the court is in session and Maharaj takes both minister's opinion.

videos.title: Rama Family's Outing
videos.overview: Tenali gets scolded by his mother badly for his decision of sending Bhaskar to Gurukul and hence Tenali has to change the decision and rather takes them for an outing and shopping as well. After returning, Tenali gets into deep thought before sleep which makes Sarada a little worried.

videos.title: Tathacharya To Suffer Again
videos.overview: Bhaskar and Kanta along with Tathacharya go to the Gurukul. Over there they can't do any mischief as he has sworn the same to his father. However, Choti Rani's brother is also there to take revenge. As a result, Kanta and Bhaskar make his way for the mischief easier.

videos.title: The Fate Of The Gurukul Invite
videos.overview: Bhaskar along with the help of Tathacharya gets into Bala's palace. He tried to steal the invitation to the gurukul from Bala. However, Bala tore the invitation but the King himself arrives and ensures that Bhaskar goes to the gurukul. On the other hand, Ramakrishna wants change in the kingdom.

videos.title: A Complete Change In Vijaynagar
videos.overview: Bhaskar has grown into an adult and is returning home from the gurukul. On the way, he is attacked by robbers but with his sharp intelligence, Bhaskar manages to thug the robbers instead. When he reaches Vijaynagar he notices that the place has deteriorated. People are indifferent to others' suffering and the vendors are thugging the civilians.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Hope Awakens
videos.overview: Bhaskar learns that everything took a U-turn in Vijaynagar after he came from the gurukul. Bhaskar was surprised to see Tathacharya in a miserable look. So he decided to raise his voice and got thrown out of the palace. Tathacharya looked shocked to see Bhaskar.

videos.title: The Wrath Of Kaikala
videos.overview: Tathacharya explains Bhaskar what happened in Vijayanagar. He quotes that Vijayanagar's bad luck brought Kaikala in the palace's doorstep. Kaikala is the uncle of Balakumar and came as a helper for him. But after getting the news from the forest, everything changed.

videos.title: Bhaskar Against Kaikala
videos.overview: Tathacharya asks Bhaskar to fight against Kaikala who keeps on torturing people who go against them. Bhaskar doesn't get convinced with Tathacharya's proposal and tries escaping away but gets into a trouble. To know the trouble, Stay tuned!

videos.title: Bhaskar Reunites With Gundappa
videos.overview: Bhaskar follows the person who had helped him and saved his life the other day. He finds him and realizes that it is his uncle Gundappa. Tathacharya, Bhaskar, and Gundappa reminisce about the good times and also hopes for the future. Stay tuned to know more!

videos.title: Kanta Saves Bhaskar
videos.overview: Bhaskar gets caught and he is also taken to Kaikala. There Ammu and Kanta are called to recognize the person who had misbehaved with princess Ammu. They both recognize Bhaskar but because of Kanta, both of them deny that it was him.

videos.title: Bhaskar Is Expelled From The Court
videos.overview: haskar urges Dhani and Mani to let him enter the court for the cause of a farmer who wants justice from a merchant. He manages to get into the court but the king orders the guards to throw him out of the court.

videos.title: Bhaskar Manipulates The Five Elements
videos.overview: Bhaskar comes to the court and advocates for Gopaiya. He works the law against Sahukar but everyone was too scared to stand as a witness. Bhaskar brings the five elements of nature as the witness to this crime. Kaikala punishes Sahukar but along with that also tells Bhaskar to immediately leave Vijayanagar.

videos.title: Tenali's Letter
videos.overview: Tathacharya applauds Bhaskar for giving justice to Gopaiya. Meanwhile, Kanta has Tenali's letter that Bhaskar must read. Bhaskar reads the letter and decides not to leave the kingdom.

videos.title: Kaikala Threatens To Kill Bhaskar
videos.overview: Bhaskar imagines that he sees his father but it was Kanta. Thereafter Bhaskar was taken by Kaikala to be killed. At that time Kaikala gets the knowledge of the presence of the popular Dacoit, Mushak in Vijayanagar. Mushak seems to know and is thinking of Bhaskar.

videos.title: Bhaskar's Mother Is Disguised As Mushak
videos.overview: Bhaskar is stopped by Tathacharya, once again. Bhaskar will meet Ramakrishna the next day on Janmashtami. This is the reason he stays back and hides in his house that is now abandoned. Mushak also separates from her gang of Dacoit. Her true identity is revealed.

videos.title: Dhani And Mani's Torture
videos.overview: Dhanicharya and Manicharya punish Tathacharya in various ways. On the other hand, Bhaskar is close to meeting his mother. Kaikala also thugs a few foreigners and takes a lot of money from them for a replica of a valuable asset. Bhaskar also teaches the vegetable seller a lesson.

videos.title: Sharda Almost Meets Bhaskar
videos.overview: Kanta and Bhaskar are busy cooking when Sharda comes to the house. She tries to see Bhaskar's face but is unable to do so. Gundappa comes and catches her from behind. They deny to identify themselves and the Gundappa sends her away. On the other hand, Tathacharya messes up big time.

videos.title: Kanta Rescues Bhaskar
videos.overview: Bhaskar runs away from Kaikala and goes to Kanta's house to stay there for the night. She is hesitant but allows him to sleep under her bed. At that time Amrapali comes to Kanta's house to give her good news. Kanta is scared but tries to manage the situation. Sharda goes back to her gang of dacoits.

videos.title: Janmashtami Celebrations
videos.overview: Kanta saves Bhaskar from being seen by Amrapali. Amrapali has some feelings for Bhaskar and that makes Kanta uncomfortable. The next day Bhaskar is excited to meet his father who has promised to meet him. Kaikala is extremely tensed as he has to give the peacock feather to his daughter.

videos.title: The Peacock Feather Confusion
videos.overview: During the ceremony of Dahi Handi, Bhaskar breaks the pot and the Peacock feather is stuck on his head. During the confusion the valuable asset goes to Tathacharya, then the commander-general. The parrot takes it away and drops it onto Sharda's pocket. Bhaskar gets caught again.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Brilliance
videos.overview: Bhaskar and his uncle are taken by Kaikala's men and are set to be sacrificed. Tathacharya comes and plays a trick to trigger Balakumar's anger for Bhaskar. As a result, he calls upon Bhaskar. This prevents Kaikala from killing them. The parrot also embarrasses Balakumar.

videos.title: Bhaskar's Weird Dilemma
videos.overview: Kaikala and Balakumar threaten Bhaskar to kill him if he doesn't tell them where the Peacock's feather is. Bhaskar is in a dilemma on whether or not to tell them who it was. He knew that it was his mother but he wants to save her.

videos.title: Bhaskar Gets Shocked In Sleep
videos.overview: Bhaskar wakes up and gets shocked seeing Nakush standing beside him and asks the reason behind his activity. Later Nakush leaves and lets Bhaskar sleep alone whereas Princess enters his room and asks him about some Peacock's feather.

videos.title: Arabs In The Market
videos.overview: Bhaskar and Kanta successfully escape in their Arab clothes. They are in search of Sharda and are trying their best. On the other hand, Sharda is scared to come out in the open. Dhani and Mani bring a weird solution for Balakumar.

videos.title: Bhaskar Continues His Search
videos.overview: Bhaskar and Kanta continue their search for Sharda in Arab clothes. At a point, Kanta looses her patience but Bhaskar asks her to be patient to find the desired thing. Bhaskar while leaving feels Sharda nearby and gets tears in his eyes.

videos.title: Amrapali Breaks Her Fast
videos.overview: Amrapali finds Bhaskar in Kanta's room. Kanta handles the situation for the moment. Bhaskar convinces Ammu to break her fast. Kaikala also gets to know about Bhaskar and Kanta.

videos.title: Sharda Recognizes Bhaskar
videos.overview: Bhaskar disguises as the Arab man and goes to the market again. There he meets Sharda and they recognize each other. However, because Nakush had come Sharda had to leave. Bhaskar tries to figure out a way to find his mother.

videos.title: The Haunted Cave
videos.overview: Bhaskar and Tathacharya together find the meaning of the symbol. The parrot tells them about the cave. Bhaskar and Tathacharya go on to the journey. The cave is said to be haunted but Bhaskar can do anything to find his family.

videos.title: Hallucinations In The Cave
videos.overview: Bhaskar sees several hallucinations in the cave. He wakes up when Tathacharya comes. They come out of the cave and waits till dawn. After dawn, they see that a village is near the cave. They go to the village in search of Sharda. Stay tuned.

videos.title: Sharda Rescues Bhaskar
videos.overview: Bhaskar gets trapped by the decoits in the village but his mother comes to his rescue. Things get emotional for both of them, and Bhaskar asks Sharda to leave with him. Meanwhile, Kaikala has called a meeting regarding Bhaskar in the palace.

videos.title: Bhaskar Fulfills His Promise
videos.overview: Bhaskar and Sharda come to the King's Court with the Peacock feather as promised. He also ensures that it be given to Ammu. After that Bhaskar also cleverly escapes a harsh punishment. Kaikala threatens him. He returns home with his mother.

videos.title: Kaikala Wants Bhaskar Gone
videos.overview: Gundappa returns from prison and is extremely hungry. Kaikala tells junior Sahukar to ensure that Bhaskar is made homeless. Junior Sahukar comes to the house and tells them about it. He also shows them the agreement made by Pandit Rama. Bhaskar has a plan.

videos.title: Bhaskar Gets Back His Home
videos.overview: Bhaskar plays with his words and with Balakumar's mind. He gets his house legally transferred to his name. Bhaskar misunderstands Tathacharya but Tathacharya understands him.

videos.title: Tenali Flees From Captive Cave
videos.overview: Bhaskar while roaming in the market with the princess gets hit by Nakush. Later Mahamatye reaches the captive cave of Tenali and there he gets the news of his escape and gets worried about the situation.

videos.title: Mahamatye's Plan
videos.overview: After knowing about the escape of Ramakrishna, Mahamatye decides to find him before he reaches Vijaynagar. Bhaskar hears secretly the convo and plan of Mahamatye and gets to know that his father is alive. Bhaskar reaches home to inform Sharda.

videos.title: Tenali's Ghost Gets Mahamatye Terrified
videos.overview: Due to an astrologer's statement, Mahamatye gets very much scared after seeing Tenali thinking him as his ghost. Tenali tries waking him up but fails and makes his way to Vijaynagar.

videos.title: A Kid's Demand
videos.overview: A kid comes to the king's court and asks for justice. he says that his parents have been killed in the fire lit in their home by the king's soldiers. They couldn't pay the taxes and their punishment was death. The kid wants justice for his parents. Stay tuned.

videos.title: Kaikala Invites His Insult

videos.title: The Secret Signals
videos.overview: Tathacharya enters the court while rubbing his hand. Rama sees this and catches this as an opportunity to tease him. Rama tells Tathacharya that the meaning of a palm itching is that he is going to get a good bashing.

videos.title: The Thought
videos.overview: The Maharaj and Maharani are sitting in their room when the Maharani asks Maharaj about the competitionby Tenali. She asks him how is what Tenali says logical in the court. Maharaj tells his wife that if Tenali has said it, there must be some thought behind it.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Excitement
videos.overview: Tathacharya is assisted by his two students in the market as he blabbers about Tenali being very cunning and about reaching the cloth shop soon. His students see an opportunity to make their teacher fall and take it. In his excitement, Tathacharya frees himself of their support.

videos.title: Collecting Witnesses
videos.overview: Tathacharya sees that Rama is buying garlands from the market. After Rama is gone, he goes to the vendors and asks them how much did Rama pay for the garlands? As he gets to know the price that Rama paid for the garlands, he asks them to become his witnesses.

videos.title: The Witnesses
videos.overview: As Tathacharya has spoken to the witnesses, he asks the vendors to speak up and all of them tell Maharaj that none of them saw Rama seeing Maharaj before spending the money. However, Rama tells Maharaj that he saw him every time before spending money.

videos.title: Turning Friends Against Each Other
videos.overview: Rama is told to solve the case of robbery. He then decides to play a trick and tells Mohan that if he accepts his crime he and Rama can split the money amongst themselves. Mohan says that it was not him and Rama tells him that he will propose the same to Sohan as well. His trick works as he turns friends against each other and Mohan tells the court about the robbery in detail.

videos.title: The Unexpected Behaviour
videos.overview: Tathacharya is hiding behind some plants as Rama and Maharaj are taking a stroll in the palace. Maharaj sees Tathacharya and asks him why is he there when Rama tells him that he is acting like that because f the dream. Tathacharya unexpectedly catches hold of Maharaj's ear. This leaves Maharaj upset as he walks away.

videos.title: A Great Saint's Advice
videos.overview: Tenali is thinking of ways to free Tathacharya from the prison when he comes across his mother and wife trying to do some heavy work. He asks them what are they trying to do when his mother asks him to hang a piece of black cloth with crushed coal inside it on the door. When he tries asking what is going on, his mother tells him that a wise saint advised it.

videos.title: One Time Is Left
videos.overview: Tathacharya is in the prison trying to think of a way to pull Maharaj's ear for one last time. He cannot think of anything to take him out of the prison to complete his task. Meanwhile, Rama goes to prison with a fake snake so as to break Tathacharya's vow.

videos.title: Maharaj Approves Rama's Plan
videos.overview: Rama is searching for Tathacharya and hopes that he does not mess up and pull Maharaj's ear again. Rama sees Maharaj and tells him that he has to go to the temple early in the morning to perform the rituals. As Maharaj is shocked and disappointed that Rama could not find a solution to the disappointing solution, Rama tells his plan and Maharaj is pleased with it. Rama tells Maharaj to stick to the plan to which Maharaj readily agrees.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Marriage Discussions
videos.overview: Tathacharya's students are eating tasty food made by the woman who wishes to get married to Tathacarya. His students tell him that he too has feeings for her but is unable to express it. As they see Tathacharya coming their way, they leave hastily.

videos.title: The Orders
videos.overview: Maharaj is telling Rama and Tathacharya about the policies for people and how it should reach the people in need. Just then, Tathacharya's students come to the court and apologize for the delay. When asked the reason for it, they tell everyone that it they encountered something no body would believe.

videos.title: Tenali Always Has A Solution!
videos.overview: Tenali decides to do what is Devi Maa has asked him to do. However, he decides to find a solution to the problem on the hands. He decides to go up the stairs in the blazing heat without a pair of shoes. However, he orders a palanquin. This solution shocks Maharaj and everyone else present.

videos.title: The Gold Treasure
videos.overview: Two of the villagers have found out some gold treasure which the Guruvar has taken away from them. When Maharaja found out about the matter in the court, he was surprised. Tenali asks Guruvar to show the treasure to everyone present in the court. Watch to find out more.

videos.title: Rama's Favourite Thing
videos.overview: Two of the villagers have found out some gold treasure which the Guruvar has taken away from them. When Maharaja found out about the matter in the court, he was surprised. Tenali asks Guruvar to show the treasure to everyone present in the court.

videos.title: Sacrificing Rama's Life
videos.overview: Rani meets the goddess and the goddess confesses that Rama should be sent to the doors of heaven. In order to send Rama to heaven, he should sacrifice his life.

videos.title: A Plan To Run Away
videos.overview: Rama comes home to see his mother and wife locking the front door of their house. Rama asks them what is happening when they tell him to enter the house via a window. He tells them that it is not called going away it is called running away.

videos.title: The Strange Occurrences
videos.overview: Tathacharya tells Maharaj that he is aware of how close Maharaj and Tenali are, however, strange occurrences like these have not happened before in Vijaynagar. Tathacharya tells Maharaj that there has to be some reason that Rama is being summoned by Devi Maa. The Maharani tries to convince Maharaj as well. However, will he comply with it?

videos.title: Memories Don't Go Away
videos.overview: As he sees Rama jump off, Maharaj is unable to forget all the times that he spent with Rama. He remembers the first time Rama came to the court and the first time he embraced Maharaj with so much love. He remembers the beginning of their friendship and he remembers how he jumped off the cliff. Maharaj is sad and can't hold back his memories and tears.

videos.title: Rama Scares The Maharani
videos.overview: Rama goes to the palace and sees that the Maharani sees him. She offers him food which he says cannot have due to him being a ghost now. The Maharani then realises that Rama had jumped off the cliff and then gets scared.

videos.title: The Truth
videos.overview: Two people are present in the court and are asking an apology from Maharaj. As the imposters tell Maharaj that they were thrown out of Vijayanagar. They wanted revenge which is why they posed as Devi and sent messages to make sure that Rama was no more. This makes Rama chuckle.

videos.title: The Laddoos
videos.overview: The Choti Maharani tells everyone that she has made laddoos for everyone. She tells them that it is a prasad and that everyone should have it. Everyone is unwilling to do so when she tells Tathacharya that it is Desi. When he asks if it is Desi Ghee, she tells him that it is Desi Neem. However unpleasant, everyone is forced to eat them.

videos.title: A Great Magician
videos.overview: As Yengadu comes back to his tent with Tathacharya, Tathacharya tells him that he saved the Maharani's life but Ramam doubted in him. Tathacharya says that it was not a good thing. Yengadu confesses that even he did not like it but didn't react to it. Yengadu then asks Tathacharya if Maharaj and Rama are close.

videos.title: A Great Magician Continues
videos.overview: All of a sudden, Maharaj tells the courtiers that if anything might happen to him in the future, or if he falls sick, the successor to the throne of Vijaynagar will be Vengadu Swami. At this announcement, everyone is shocked and no one knows what to say next or do next.

videos.title: Tathacharya's Joyous Walk
videos.overview: Tathacharya walks in the court with joy and royal attitude. He thinks to himself about how his friend Vengdu will have already woven a web of lies about Rama in front of Maharaj. As Tathacharya walks in with the manner he does, Rama asks him about what is such good news that he is walking the way he is. Tathacharya tells him that he should be worrying and thinking about himself rather than Tathacharya's walk.

videos.title: Confusing Vengadu
videos.overview: Rama disguises himself as a guard and along with another guard, he tells Vengadu that it is already morning. Vengadu asks Rama that why is he only able to hear the crows scream and no other bird. Rama tells that it is the topic for discussion in the court. Vengadu says that he will not fall prey to these tricks. However, Rama remains firm on his statement.

videos.title: The New Juice
videos.overview: Choti Maharani sees the Badi Maharani sleeping and tries to wake her up. She tells the Badi Maharani that she has gotten a specially made juice of radish and eggplant with black pepper. She tells the Badi Maharani that she made so that it will make her feel better. However, the Badi Maharani politely denies her.

videos.title: A Blind Life
videos.overview: Rama tells Vengadu that as he is not ready to accept his crime, he will have to live a life without sight. He tells Vengadu that he has very little time left to confess his mistake. When Vengadu tells Rama that he is blaming him for no reason. Rama orders the guard to extinguish the torch. Vengadu tells Rama that he does not want to live a blind life.

videos.title: Accepting The Challenge
videos.overview: Two guests come and tell Maharaj that if any one in Vijaynagar can complete their challenge, they will be paid 2,000 gold coins. Upon listening to the prize, Tathacharya accepts the challenge without hesitation. As Rama tries to talk to him, Tathacharya tells Rama that he knows what he is doing.

videos.title: A Stupid Mistake
videos.overview: As Tathacharya is unable to complete his task, Abdullah and his wife tell him that they will seize his house. Dhani and Mani tell Tathacharya that it will be possible only when they can come inside the house. They tell him that they locked the house from outside. However, Abdullah comes in through the window and tells them that the mistake they made was leaving the ladder near the window.

videos.title: Queen Loses Her Jewelry
videos.overview: The King of Vijayanagar calls for an urgent meeting to state the fact that the Queen has lost her Jewelry. Calls it a great insult and states that the culprit will be punished. Watch the full episode.

videos.title: Rama Gets Sentimental
videos.overview: King of Vijayanagar and Rama are in deep thinking about what has happened and what needs to be done. Rama thinks about the time he was insulted and gets sentimental.

videos.title: Rama Asks Permission To Leave
videos.overview: Rama says Raja Krishnadevaraya that he wants to leave Vijayanagar and go back to his hometown. Everyone gets emotional listening to Rama.

videos.title: Tenali Rama's Goodbye
videos.overview: Raja Krishnadevara names Rama as Tenali Rama and everyone cherishes the name. Tenali Rama gets sentimental and thanks to the king.  ---- THE END ----
